t1547224.director: エミリア・エクマン・ラーソン
t1547224.synopsis: 北欧スウェーデンを代表する陶芸家リサ・ラーソンの人生と最期の日々を、孫娘である映画監督エミリア・エクマン・ラーソンがとらえたドキュメンタリー。 赤と白のしま模様の猫「マイキー」やハリネズミ「ハリエット」といったキャラクターや、丸みを帯びた愛らしい動物・子どもなどの陶器作品が、世代や国境を越えて愛され続けてきたリサ・ラーソン。2024年に92歳でこの世を去った彼女の晩年の姿を、映画監督である実孫エミリアが2017年から8年間にわたって記録した。人生と創作のパートナーであり続けた画家の夫グンナル・ラーソンとの出会いと別れ、子どもや孫たちに対する深い愛情、スウェーデンが誇る陶磁器メーカー・グスタフスベリで数々のヒット作を生み出し、多くの人々に愛される陶芸家になるまでの道のりなど、リサはエミリアの好奇心に満ちたまなざしに導かれながら、生涯を通して創作と向き合い続けた自身の人生を振り返っていく。その親密で飾らない姿から、ひとりの人間としてのリサの素顔を浮かび上がらせるとともに、彼女の豊かな創作世界を映し出す。 スウェーデン出身でラーソン一家と親交のある映画コメンテーターのLiLiCoが日本語字幕を担当。
t1547224.synopsis_en: The true face and life of Lisa Larson, creator of Nordic "cuteness," and her final days— Here is a side of her that even fans don't yet know. After watching, you'll love Lisa even more! Film commentator LiLiCo handled the Japanese subtitles! "While everyone in my school class knew my grandmother, to me she was somehow a mysterious presence—" Starting from this thought, Emilia continued filming Lisa Larson with her camera over eight years beginning in 2017. Her meeting and parting with painter Gunnar Larson, who was her partner in life and creation for over 70 years, her deep love for her children and grandchildren, and her journey to becoming a ceramicist who created numerous hits at Gustavsberg, Sweden's proud ceramics manufacturer, and became beloved by many people... Guided by Emilia's curious gaze, Lisa looks back on her own life. Through her intimate, unadorned appearance, the true face of Lisa Larson as a human being—beyond the title of "world-renowned ceramicist"—emerges.
t1547224.tmdb_overview_en: Lisa Larson is one of Sweden’s most beloved ceramicists, known for her round, playful animal and child figures. But when director Emilia Ekman Larson digs up her grandmother’s 30-year-old discarded sculptures, she can’t help but wonder why they look so sorrowful.

t1495096.synopsis: フィンランドを代表するロックミュージシャンで、グラフィックデザイナーや作家としても活動するヘッラ・ウルッポが長編映画初監督を務めたシュールレアリズムSF。これまで数十本のミュージックビデオを手がけてきたウルッポ監督が、自身の体験をもとにした離婚と喪失、再生の物語を、スペイン・アンダルシアの山岳地帯で撮影した幻想的な風景とモノクロームの映像美、ブラックユーモアを交錯させながら独創的に描き出す。 男は誕生日祝いの席で、女から「新しい男ができた」と告げられる。そっと頬をなでて去っていく彼女には、すでに新しい恋人がいた。それ以来、男の耳の奥では鳴り止まない音が響きはじめる。壊れた均衡を取り戻すため旅に出た男は、荒野で出会った甲殻類アレルギーの殺し屋を相棒に、不可解な出来事の連鎖へと足を踏み入れていく。 フィンランドの映画館「キノ・ライカ」を映画監督アキ・カウリスマキと共同経営することでも知られる作家ミカ・ラッティが共同脚本と製作を務め、劇中にも出演している。
t1495096.synopsis_en: A surrealist science fiction film marking the feature directorial debut of Hella Urppo, a leading Finnish rock musician who also works as a graphic designer and writer. Director Urppo, who has helmed dozens of music videos, draws on her own experiences of divorce, loss, and rebirth, weaving a uniquely original tale set against the fantastical landscapes of Andalusia, Spain, intercut with monochrome visual beauty and black humor. At a birthday celebration, a man is told by a woman, 'I've found someone new.' She strokes his cheek and leaves—she already has a new lover. Since then, a persistent ringing echoes in the man's ears. Setting out on a journey to restore his broken equilibrium, he encounters a crustacean-allergic hitman in the wilderness, who becomes his partner as he steps into a chain of inexplicable events. Writer Mika Latti, known for co-managing the Finnish cinema 'Kino Laika' with filmmaker Aki Kaurismäki, co-wrote the script and produced, also appearing in the film.
t1495096.tmdb_overview_en: A timeless, stark, black-and-white landscape, ruthless to its inhabitant, sets the stage for the cosmic pain of separation. Right at the start, Mira Luoti’s sullen modern Dulcinea announces that she has found another man, and the jilted wanderer (Toni “Protoni” Järvinen) sinks into a blurry in-between zone that rings in the ears and bends the broken mind. He finds a shellfish-allergic contract killer as his companion/squire, and it soon becomes clear that righting past wrongs will essentially be about building a new stripper pole.

genres: サイエンスフィクション
t8426.synopsis: 岩井俊二監督が「Love Letter」に続いて手がけた長編第2作。架空の無国籍都市・円都で暮らす移民たちの物語を、独自の世界観で描き出す。 「円」が世界で一番強かった頃。日本にやって来た移民たちが街を「円都（イェンタウン）」と呼ぶ一方で、日本人はこの名前を忌み嫌い、移民たちを「円盗（イェンタウン）」と呼んで蔑んだ。母親を亡くした少女は、胸にアゲハ蝶のタトゥーを入れた娼婦グリコに引き取られ、アゲハと名付けられる。グリコは歌手を夢見て上海からやって来た「円盗」だった。アゲハはグリコの紹介で、彼女の恋人フェイホンや謎の男ランと出会い、ランが営むなんでも屋で働きはじめる。ある日、アゲハはグリコの客・須藤に襲われたところを元ボクサーのアーロウに助けられ、死んでしまった須藤の腹から1本のカセットテープを見つける。同じ頃、中国系マフィアのボスであるリャンキが、須藤とカセットテープの行方を追っていた。 小林武史が音楽を手がけ、劇中でChara演じるグリコがボーカルを務めるバンド「YEN TOWN BAND」の楽曲が実際にリリースされ大ヒットを記録。少女アゲハを伊藤歩、フェイホンを三上博史、リャンキを江口洋介が演じた。1996年の公開から30周年となる2026年、岩井俊二監修のもと4Kリマスター・Dolby Atoms化されてリバイバル公開。
t8426.synopsis_en: The second feature film directed by Shunji Iwai, following "Love Letter." It depicts the stories of immigrants living in the fictional stateless city of "Yentown" through his unique worldview. At a time when the yen was the strongest currency in the world, immigrants who came to Japan called the city "Yentown," while the Japanese despised the name and scornfully called the immigrants "Yentown" (thieves). A girl who lost her mother is taken in by Glico, a prostitute with a swallowtail butterfly tattoo on her chest, and is named Ageha. Glico is a "Yentown" who came from Shanghai dreaming of becoming a singer. Through Glico, Ageha meets her lover Feihong and a mysterious man named Ran, and begins working at Ran's odd-jobs shop. One day, Ageha is attacked by Glico's client Sutou but is saved by a former boxer named Arlow, and finds a cassette tape in the belly of the dead Sutou. Around the same time, Liangqi, a Chinese mafia boss, is searching for Sutou and the cassette tape. Music was handled by Takeshi Kobayashi, and the band "YEN TOWN BAND," with Chara performing as Glico on vocals, actually released songs from the film and became a huge hit. Ito Aoi plays the girl Ageha, Mikami Hiroshi plays Feihong, and Eguchi Yosuke plays Liangqi. In 2026, marking the 30th anniversary since its 1996 release, a 4K remastered and Dolby Atmos version was revived in theaters under the supervision of Shunji Iwai.
t8426.tmdb_overview_en: The struggles of a group of outcasts living in "Yentown", in an alternate-future Japan.
t8426.tmdb_overview_jp: 紙幣偽造のデータを手に入れた娼婦のグリコは、中国系移民のヒョウたちとニセ札造りを始めた。ライブハウスを買い取り、歌手として有名になっていく彼女だったが……。近未来の架空の都市“円都（イェンタウン）”を舞台に、若者たちの姿を描いた作品。

t1651263.synopsis: 日常的に暴力を振るう夫から逃げてきた紀子。絶望の中、入院先の看護師・路子に救われ、配偶者や親から暴力を受けた女性たちを匿うシェルター〈おうち〉に身を寄せる。そこでは暮らしのすべてが「持ち回り」というルールで成り立っていた。穏やかで守られた日々を取り戻していく紀子だが、少しずつ違和感を覚え始める。やがて〈おうち〉が“交換殺人”によって女性たちを解放している事実を知る。残るか去るか、選択を迫られる紀子。一方、とある事件を追う刑事・薫もまた夫からの暴力に苦しんでいた。疑われることのない夫・晋一と追い詰められていく現実のなかで、薫は事件の先に〈おうち〉の存在へと辿り着く。そして晋一の存在によって、その均衡が崩されていく──。
t1651263.synopsis_en: A crime suspense film adaptation of the novel of the same name by Hiroshi Sano, winner of the 66th Edogawa Ranpo Award, starring Riho Yoshioka and Nao in a double lead, set in a shelter where women suffering violence from spouses or parents take refuge. Directed and written by Ryuhei Yoshino of "You Are Younger Than Those Guys Forever." Noriko, who escaped her husband's violence, loses her place and is saved by nurse Michiko, who brings her to "Ouchi," a shelter in a Japanese-style house on the outskirts of Miura Beach. At that place, which shelters women who have suffered violence from spouses or parents, everything in daily life—cooking, cleaning, and so on—is governed by a rule of "taking turns." Noriko regains a peaceful, protected daily life, but gradually begins to feel something off about that routine. And finally, she learns the truth of the organized crime being carried out at "Ouchi." Meanwhile, Detective Kaoru, pursuing a certain case, also begins to see the existence of "Ouchi" emerge in her investigation. Riho Yoshioka, who won the Best Supporting Actress award at the 48th Japan Academy Awards for "Identity," plays Noriko, and Nao, who won the Best Actress award at the 2025 Tokyo Drama Award, plays Detective Kaoru. Jun Fubuki, Jun Miho, Wakana Sakai, First Summer Uika, Emi Satsuki, and other colorful faces play the women of "Ouchi," while Takumi Kitamura, Yoshitaka Hara, and Naoya Shimizu play the figures who threaten the women.
t1651263.tmdb_overview_jp: 吉岡里帆×奈緒 W主演 2026年全国公開映画『シャドウワーク』

t1400789.director: ミスティスラフ・チェルノフ
t1400789.synopsis: 2024年・第96回アカデミー賞で長編ドキュメンタリー賞を受賞した「マリウポリの20日間」のミスティスラフ・チェルノフ監督が、ロシアによるウクライナ侵攻の最前線をとらえたドキュメンタリー。 2023年、チェルノフ監督はウクライナ軍第3強襲旅団の小隊に同行し、ロシア軍に占領されたアンドリーウカ村の奪還作戦を記録する。兵士たちは2000メートル先に位置するアンドリーウカ村を目指し、死と隣り合わせの極限の道のりを、身を潜めながら前進していく。チェルノフ監督は兵士たちと行動を共にしながら戦場に身を置き、兵士のヘルメットカメラやドローンを中心に撮影する。冗談を交わし、家族や未来について語り、その直後に命を落としていく若い兵士たち。銃を手にする以前はそれぞれの日常を生きていたひとりの人間としての彼らの姿を見つめるとともに、激しい銃撃戦やドローンによる襲撃、絶え間なく降り注ぐ砲弾や荒廃した大地に横たわる戦死体など、ニュース映像や数字だけでは決して伝わらない戦場の現実を生々しく映し出す。 2025年・第41回サンダンス映画祭のワールドシネマ・ドキュメンタリー部門にて監督賞を受賞。
t1400789.synopsis_en: A documentary by director Mstyslav Chernov, who won the Best Documentary Feature Film award at the 96th Academy Awards in 2024 for "20 Days in Mariupol," capturing the front lines of Russia's invasion of Ukraine. In 2023, director Chernov accompanies a platoon of the Ukrainian 3rd Assault Brigade, documenting their operation to recapture the village of Andriivka, which had been occupied by Russian forces. The soldiers aim for the village of Andriivka, located 2000 meters away, advancing while concealing themselves on a journey to the brink of death. Chernov embeds himself on the battlefield alongside the soldiers, filming primarily with the soldiers' helmet cameras and drones. Young soldiers who joke, talk about their families and futures, and then lose their lives moments later. The film gazes upon them as individual human beings who lived their own daily lives before taking up arms, while also vividly depicting the reality of war that news footage and numbers alone can never convey: intense firefights, drone attacks, incessant shelling, and the war dead lying across the devastated land. Won the Directing Award in the World Cinema Documentary category at the 2025 Sundance Film Festival.
t1400789.tmdb_overview_en: Amid the failing counteroffensive, a journalist follows a Ukrainian platoon on their mission to traverse one mile of heavily fortified forest and liberate a strategic village from Russian occupation. But the farther they advance through their destroyed homeland, the more they realize that this war may never end.

nundopicnic4kリマスター.synopsis: アトリエのような住まいで暮らす萌実（山口智子）と由起夫（豊川悦司）。 ある時、萌実は身の回りの物をヒモで縛りつけるという不可解な行動をとるようになる。 ペットの亀を縛り、編み物をする自らの手を縛る萌実を危惧し、萌実を精神科医（田口トモロヲ）のもとへ連れて行く由起夫。診察を受けたところ“強迫性緊縛症候群”の診断を下された。 症状は進行し、萌実はついに目に見えないものまで縛り始めるのだった。
nundopicnic4kリマスター.synopsis_en: Moemi (Tomoko Yamaguchi) and Yukio (Etsushi Toyokawa) live in a home that resembles an artist's atelier. At some point, Moemi begins to engage in the incomprehensible behavior of tying up the things around her with string. Worried about Moemi, who ties up their pet turtle and binds her own hands while knitting, Yukio takes her to a psychiatrist (Tomorowo Taguchi). After an examination, she is diagnosed with "obsessive binding syndrome." The symptoms progress, and Moemi finally begins to bind even things that cannot be seen.

n沼影市民プール.synopsis: 埼玉県さいたま市の沼影市民プールが営業を終えるまでの49日間を記録したドキュメンタリー。 「海なき市にプールを」という市民の願いから1971年に誕生した沼影市民プールは、人々の憩いと出会い、そして健康を支える場として、52年間で約600万人が訪れた。しかし2021年、さいたま市はプールの解体と、小中一貫校の建設を発表する。存続を求めて900通を超えるパブリックコメントや1万人以上からの署名が寄せられたものの計画は進み、2024年3月、沼影市民プールは静かにその役目を終えた。 「わたしたちに許された特別な時間の終わり」「解放区」などの太田信吾監督が、沼影市民プールが営業終了の日を迎えるまでの49日間にカメラを向け、公共施設の喪失が市民に何をもたらすのかを見つめていく。制作段階において、チェコのカルロヴィ・ヴァリ国際映画祭2024にて日本企画として初となる「First Cut+ Works in Progress Award」を受賞。完成後も第30回釜山国際映画祭ワイドアングル部門、第27回テッサロニキ国際ドキュメンタリー映画祭などに出品された。
n沼影市民プール.synopsis_en: A documentary recording the final 49 days of Numakage Civic Pool in Saitama City, Saitama Prefecture, until it closed its doors for good. Born in 1971 from citizens' wishes for "a pool in a city without a sea," Numakage Civic Pool served as a place of rest, encounter, and health for the community, visited by approximately 6 million people over 52 years. However, in 2021, Saitama City announced the pool's demolition and the construction of an integrated elementary and junior high school. Despite over 900 public comments and petitions signed by more than 10,000 people calling for its preservation, the plan proceeded, and in March 2024, Numakage Civic Pool quietly ended its role. Director Shingo Ota, known for works like "The End of the Special Time We Were Allowed" and "Liberated Zone," turns his camera on the 49 days leading up to the pool's final day of operation, examining what the loss of a public facility brings to citizens. During the production phase, it became the first Japanese project to receive the "First Cut+ Works in Progress Award" at the Karlovy Vary International Film Festival 2024 in the Czech Republic. After completion, it was also screened at the 30th Busan International Film Festival's Wide Angle section and the 27th Thessaloniki International Documentary Festival.

t1422637.director: ユナイテッドピープル
t1422637.tmdb_overview_en: Dear Tomorrow is a multi-character story about loneliness. Set in Japan, the film centers around the mental health hotline called “A Place for You”, where a group of young volunteers are chatting with thousands in need, every single day.

nブロークンヴォイス.movie_title: ブロークン・ヴォイス
nブロークンヴォイス.movie_title_jp: ブロークン・ヴォイス
nブロークンヴォイス.director: オンドジェイ・プロバズニーク
nブロークンヴォイス.synopsis: チェコ・プラハの名門少年少女合唱団「バンビーニ・ディ・プラーガ」をめぐる実在の性的虐待事件に着想を得て制作されたドラマ。ひとりの少女のまなざしを通して、才能と成功、そして沈黙が結びつき歪められていく過程を映し出す。 共産主義体制が終わりを迎え、社会全体に自由の空気が流れはじめた1990年代初頭のチェコ。カンティチェラ少女合唱団のBチームに所属する13歳のヴァレリエは、選抜チームの姉ルチエの背中を追い奮闘する日々を過ごしていた。ある日、指揮者のヴィテクがBチームの練習に現れ、ヴァレリエを指名して歌わせる。海外ツアーを前に選抜メンバーを決める雪山合宿が始まると、欠員の代役として呼ばれたヴァレリエに、ヴィテクは楽譜を手渡し覚えるよう告げる。少女たちの間では競争と嫉妬が渦巻き、ささやかな悪意が日常に紛れ込むが、それでもヴァレリエは選ばれるため歌い続ける。やがてヴァレリエはヴィテクから特別に扱われるようになり、ついに正式な団員となるが……。 日本では「チェコ少年少女合唱団」としても知られるキーン少年少女合唱団に所属するカテジナ・ファルブロバーが主人公ヴァレリエを繊細かつ力強く演じ、劇中歌曲を自ら歌唱した。監督・脚本は、本作が長編第2作となるチェコの新鋭オンドジェイ・プロバズニーク。
nブロークンヴォイス.synopsis_en: A drama inspired by a real-life sexual abuse case involving the prestigious Czech boys' and girls' choir "Bambini di Praga" in Prague. Through the eyes of a single girl, it depicts the process by which talent, success, and silence become intertwined and distorted. In the early 1990s Czech Republic, as the communist regime came to an end and a spirit of freedom began to flow through society, 13-year-old Valerie, a member of the B team of the Cantichiera Girls' Choir, spent her days struggling to follow in the footsteps of her older sister Lucie, who was on the select team. One day, conductor Vitek appears at a B team rehearsal and singles out Valerie to sing. When a mountain snow camp begins to determine the select members ahead of an overseas tour, Valerie is called in as a substitute for an absent member, and Vitek hands her sheet music and tells her to memorize it. Competition and jealousy swirl among the girls, and petty malice blends into daily life, but Valerie keeps singing in order to be chosen. Eventually, Valerie comes to be treated specially by Vitek and finally becomes an official member, but... Katerina Falbrova, who belongs to the Keene Boys' and Girls' Choir, also known in Japan as the "Czech Boys' and Girls' Choir," delicately yet powerfully portrays the protagonist Valerie and performs the songs in the film herself. The director and screenwriter is Czech newcomer Ondrej Provaznik, for whom this is his second feature film.

t29845.synopsis: 精神を病んだ妻とその夫の愛と葛藤を描き、ジョン・カサベテス監督の代表作の1つとなった傑作ドラマ。 専業主婦のメイベルは、土木工事の現場監督を務める夫ニックや3人の子どもたちと暮らしている。精神バランスの不安定なメイベルは、ある晩ニックが仕事での突発的なトラブルで帰宅できなかったことを発端に、異常な行動を見せるようになり……。 カサベテス監督の旧友ピーター・フォークと妻ジーナ・ローランズが主人公夫婦に扮する。
t29845.synopsis_en: A masterpiece drama depicting the love and conflict between a mentally ill wife and her husband, and one of director John Cassavetes' representative works. Mabel, a housewife, lives with her husband Nick, who works as a foreman on a construction site, and their three children. One night, when Nick is unable to come home due to a sudden problem at work, Mabel, whose mental balance is unstable, begins to behave abnormally... Cassavetes' old friend Peter Falk and his wife Gena Rowlands play the married couple at the center of the story.
t29845.tmdb_overview_en: Mabel Longhetti, desperate and lonely, is married to a Los Angeles municipal construction worker, Nick. Increasingly unstable, especially in the company of others, she craves happiness, but her extremely volatile behavior convinces Nick that she poses a danger to their family and decides to commit her to an institution for six months. Alone with a trio of kids to raise on his own, he awaits her return, which holds more than a few surprises.

t687163.movie_title: プロジェクト・ヘイル・メアリー
t687163.movie_title_jp: プロジェクト・ヘイル・メアリー
t687163.clean_title_jp: プロジェクト・ヘイル・メアリー
genres: サイエンスフィクション
t687163.synopsis_en: A film adaptation of the bestselling science fiction novel by Andy Weir, author of "The Martian" (the basis for the Oscar-nominated "The Martian"). It depicts a middle school science teacher entrusted with the fate of Earth on the brink of extinction, who encounters an unknown life form with the same purpose at the edge of the universe, and together they risk their lives to save their home planets. An unexplained anomaly occurs where the sun's energy is being drained. If this continues, Earth will freeze and humanity will perish. It is discovered that the same phenomenon is happening not only to the sun but to countless stars scattered across the universe, and a single intact star is found 11.9 light-years away. Humanity's only remaining option is to travel to that star in a spaceship and solve the mystery to save the sun and humanity. Sent into space for this "Hail Mary" project is Grace, a brilliant scientist who left academia and now works as a humble middle school teacher. Alone in the vastness of space far from Earth, he relies on his scientific knowledge to tackle the mission, where he meets Rocky, an alien also struggling to save his home planet. Despite their different forms and languages, the two use science as a common language to face challenges, developing a friendship along the way. Ryan Gosling of "La La Land" and "Barbie" plays the protagonist middle school teacher Grace, with Sandra Hüller of "Anatomy of a Fall" and "The Zone of Interest" co-starring. Drew Goddard, who also worked on "The Martian," wrote the screenplay, and Phil Lord & Christopher Miller, known for producing and writing the "Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse" series, directed.
t687163.tmdb_overview_en: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

t16646.movie_title: エルミタージュ幻想 ＜アレクサンドル・ソクーロフ特集＞
t16646.synopsis_en: Russian master Alexander Sokurov presents this 2002 work set in the world heritage site, the Hermitage Museum. Created with a single 90-minute continuous shot, a first in film history, it depicts a time travel where past and present intertwine. Guided by the narration of the 19th-century French diplomat, the Marquis de Custine, and Sokurov himself, the film journeys through the interior of Russia's pride, the Hermitage Museum. Within the halls lined with masterpieces by Raphael, da Vinci, Rembrandt, and El Greco, 300 years of Russian history unfold. They encounter historical figures—sometimes Peter the Great, sometimes Catherine the Great at the theater, sometimes the last supper of Nicholas II as revolution looms. Using the museum interior with its artworks still on display as the stage, the movements of actors and crowds are unified to depict 300 years of Russian history in a single continuous image. Conductor Valery Gergiev makes a special appearance, with music performed by the Mariinsky Theatre Orchestra. The film caused a stir when it was first released in Japanese theaters in 2003, and a digitally remastered version is set for re-release in September 2026.
t16646.tmdb_overview_en: A ghost and a French marquis wander through the Winter Palace in St Petersburg, encountering scenes from many different periods of its history.

t1466682.movie_title: 金子文子　何が私をこうさせたか
t1466682.movie_title_jp: 金子文子 何が私をこうさせたか
t1466682.clean_title_jp: 金子文子 何が私をこうさせたか
t1466682.movie_title_original: 金子文子 何が私をこうさせたか
t1466682.synopsis_en: This biographical drama centers on Fumiko Kaneko, a nihilist and anarchist who fiercely resisted Japan's state power about 100 years ago, depicting the 121 days from her death sentence to her suicide in prison. Directed by female filmmaker Sachi Hamano (known for "Yukiko-san no Ashioto"), the film draws on tanka poems that convey Kaneko's own voice to portray her solitary struggle. Born in 1903, Kaneko grew up as a "non-registered person" because her father never filed her birth registration. At age nine, she was sent to live with her grandmother and aunt in Korea, where she suffered abuse akin to slavery from a family that exploited the colonized Korean villagers. In 1919, she witnessed the March First Independence Movement in Korea. Sent back to her mother's home in Yamanashi at 16, she later struggled through poverty in Tokyo, moving ideologically from Christianity to socialism, anarchism, and finally nihilism. She eventually met Park Yeol, a Korean independence activist who had fled to Japan. Becoming comrades and lovers, they campaigned against Japanese imperialism and colonialism, but were arrested during the 1923 Great Kanto Earthquake and sentenced to death. After her sentence was commuted to life imprisonment through amnesty, Kaneko was sent to Tochigi Women's Prison, where she continued her solitary fight behind bars. Nanana stars as Kaneko, embodying the soulful cry of a woman who defied state power to the end. Katsuya Kobayashi plays Park Yeol, with supporting performances by Masaki Miura, Yoko Horaguchi, and Kazuko Yoshiyuki.
t1466682.tmdb_overview_en: Why did she die? The Supreme Court first sentenced her to death, but then commuted her sentence to life imprisonment and sent her to Tochigi Women's Prison. What happened before she took her own life there? Based on her tanka poems, which convey her raw voice, the film explores her lone fight during the 121 days between her death sentence and suicide, a period that has remained obscure to date.
t1466682.tmdb_overview_jp: 金子文子はなぜ死んだのか。大審院で死刑判決を受けた後、無期懲役に減刑され、栃木女子刑務所に送られた。自死するまで何があったのか。本映画では文子のナマの声を伝える短歌をもとに、これまで空白であった死刑判決から自死に至る121日間の、文子のたったひとりの闘いを描きます。

t175041.synopsis_en: Ryoya Maeda belongs to the film club at a prefectural high school in a rural town. Though he is plain and inconspicuous in class, his passion for film is stronger than anyone else's. The students at his school go about their daily lives—some diligently participating in club activities on Friday afternoons as usual, while others with time on their hands play basketball as members of the go-home club. One day, Kirishima, the captain of the most popular volleyball team in school, quits the club. This triggers a wave of unease that begins to spread through the relationships among the various clubs and classmates.
t175041.tmdb_overview_en: A story about the disappearance of Kirishima, a star athlete of the volleyball club, and how his disappearance affects every person in school.
t175041.tmdb_overview_jp: とある田舎町の県立高校映画部に所属する前田涼也は、クラスの中では地味で目立たないものの、映画に対する情熱が人一倍強い人物だった。そんな彼の学校の生徒たちは、金曜日の放課後、いつもと変わらず部活に励み、一方暇を持て余す帰宅部がバスケに興じるなど、それぞれの日常を過ごしていた。ある日、学校で一番人気があるバレー部のキャプテン桐島が退部。それをきっかけに、各部やクラスの人間関係に動揺が広がり始めていく。

t49964.synopsis_en: An Iranian film that vividly captures a boy's journey to find his friend's house to return a precious notebook he accidentally took home, bringing director Abbas Kiarostami international fame. At a primary school in the village of Koker in northern Iran, Mohammad is severely scolded by his teacher for doing his homework on a piece of paper instead of a notebook and is told he will be expelled if it happens again. However, his best friend Ahmad, who sits next to him, accidentally takes Mohammad's notebook home. Panicked that Mohammad will be expelled without his notebook, Ahmad searches for his friend's house in a distant neighboring village to return it, but struggles to find it... A digital remastered version was screened as part of the special program "And Kiarostami Continues" (from October 16, 2021, at Eurospace in Tokyo and other venues).
t49964.tmdb_overview_en: An 8-year-old boy must return his friend's notebook he took by mistake, lest his friend be punished by expulsion from school.
t49964.tmdb_overview_jp: 間違って友だちのノートを持ち帰ってしまった少年が、ノートを返そうと隣村へと走る! キアロスタミ監督の名を世界的なものにした作品で、通称“ジグザグ道3部作”と呼ばれる作品の第1作。

t1403864.synopsis_en: Kanako Saotome begins living with a friend when she enters university. At the entrance ceremony, she meets Nagatsuda, an aspiring screenwriter in the theater circle "Charing Cross," and they start dating. She finishes job hunting and lands a position at the major publishing company she had dreamed of. She and Nagatsuda have been together for four years, but lately they argue constantly. Nagatsuda only talks big, never finishes writing a script, and shows no intention of graduating. There are even suspicions that he is cheating with Maiko, a first-year student from a women's university who joined the circle. Just then, Kanako receives a confession from Yoshizawa, a senior colleague at her future employer. As Kanako pursues her dream of becoming an editor, she and Nagatsuda gradually drift apart in their ways of life.
t1403864.tmdb_overview_en: Kanako, a college senior, is torn between her unreliable ex Keishi and her steady new admirer Yoichi. As Keishi grows close to a freshman named Maiko, and Yoichi’s ex Aiko moves on, Kanako must decide what—and who—she really wants.
t1403864.tmdb_overview_jp: 大学進学と同時に友達と二人暮らしを始めた早乙女カナコ。入学式で演劇サークル「チャリングクロス」で脚本家を目指す長津田と出会い、そのまま付き合うことに。就職活動を終え、念願の大手出版社に就職が決まる。長津田とも４年の付き合いになるが、このところ口げんかが絶えない。⻑津田は、口ばかりで脚本を最後まで書かず、卒業もする気はなさそう。サークルに入ってきた女子大の1年生・麻衣子と浮気疑惑さえある。そんなとき、カナコは内定先の先輩・吉沢から告白される。編集者になる夢を追うカナコは、長津田の生き方とだんだんとすれ違っていく。

nスターヴエイカー召喚.director: ダニエル・ココタジロ
nスターヴエイカー召喚.synopsis: イギリスのヨークシャー地方を舞台に、幼い息子を失った夫婦が、土地に秘められた伝承に翻弄され想像を絶する恐怖にのみ込まれていく姿を描いたフォークホラー。 考古学者のリチャードと妻ジュリエットは幼い息子オーウェンを連れ、ヨークシャー地方の人里離れた土地スターヴ・エイカーに移り住む。しかしオーウェンが“何かの声”を聞きはじめたことで、家族の日常は揺らぎはじめる。ある日、オーウェンがぜん息発作で命を落としてしまう。愛する息子の死は夫婦のあいだに深い溝を生み、喪失にとらわれたふたりは土地に眠る古い伝承に引き寄せられていく。リチャードは古いオークの根を掘り起こし、ジュリエットは亡き息子の魂との交信に救いを求めるようになる。彼らが気づかないうちに家の中へ招き入れた邪悪な力は、“失われたものを取り戻せる”というおぞましい可能性を差し出す。 テレビドラマ「ドクター・フー」シリーズの11代目ドクター役として知られるマット・スミスが夫リチャード、「セイント・モード　狂信」「クロール　凶暴領域」のモーフィッド・クラークが妻ジュリエットを演じ、テレビドラマ「GOTHAM ゴッサム」のエリン・リチャーズ、テレビドラマ「キャシアン・アンドー」のロバート・エムズが共演。監督・脚本は、本作が長編映画第2作となるダニエル・ココタジロ。
nスターヴエイカー召喚.synopsis_en: A folk horror film set in Yorkshire, England, depicting a couple who have lost their young son, as they are toyed with by the folklore hidden in the land and consumed by unimaginable terror. Archaeologist Richard and his wife Juliette move with their young son Owen to a remote piece of land in Yorkshire called Starve Acre. However, when Owen begins hearing "a voice," the family's daily life starts to unravel. One day, Owen dies from an asthma attack. The death of their beloved son creates a deep rift between the couple, and consumed by loss, they are drawn to the old folklore sleeping in the land. Richard digs up an old oak root, while Juliette seeks solace in communicating with her dead son's spirit. The evil force they unknowingly invite into their home offers the horrifying possibility of "reclaiming what has been lost." Matt Smith, known for his role as the Eleventh Doctor in the TV series "Doctor Who," plays the husband Richard, and Morfydd Clark of "Saint Maud" and "Crawl" plays the wife Juliette. Erin Richards of the TV series "Gotham" and Robert Emms of "Andor" also co-star. The director and screenwriter is Daniel Kokotajlo, for whom this is his second feature film.

n雌鶏.synopsis: ストーリー 養鶏場で生まれ育った1 羽の雌鶏が、出荷用トラックから脱走！人生初の自由を手に入れた彼女は、刺激と危険に満ちた世界を走り抜け、ワケあり一家が暮らす家へと辿り着く。庭に建つニワトリ小屋で新生活を送るなか、初恋を知り、初めて産んだ卵を温め育てようと決意する。ところが大切な卵は毎日人間に回収されてしまう過酷な現実に直面。人生とは？生きるとは？雌鶏は我が子がヒヨコになる日を夢見る一方、飼い主一家はとある事件に巻き込まれる。そこには両者にとって思いがけない運命が待ち受けていた――。
n雌鶏.synopsis_en: A hen born and raised on a poultry farm escapes from a shipping truck! Having gained freedom for the first time in her life, she runs through a world full of excitement and danger, eventually arriving at a house where a family with complications lives. While living a new life in a chicken coop in the garden, she experiences first love and decides to incubate and raise the first egg she lays. However, she faces the harsh reality that her precious eggs are collected by humans every day. What is life? What is living? While the hen dreams of the day her children become chicks, the owner family gets caught up in a certain incident. An unexpected fate awaits them both——

t9517.synopsis: 「KIDS キッズ」のラリー・クラーク監督が、1993年に米フロリダ州で実際に起きた殺人事件を題材に、若者たちの退屈や欲望、支配、暴力を描いた青春犯罪ドラマ。 南フロリダの郊外。幼なじみのボビーとマーティは、いつも行動をともにしていた。しかしボビーは暴力によってマーティを支配し、マーティは傷つきながらもボビーから離れられずにいた。そんな彼らの前に、奔放な少女アリと、その友人リサが現れる。マーティに恋をしたリサは、彼をボビーの支配から救い出そうとし、アリもまたボビーの残酷さを目の当たりにする。ボビーさえいなくなれば、すべてが終わるのではないか。冗談のように口にされた殺意は、やがて仲間を巻き込み、現実の計画へと変わっていく。そしてある夏の夜、彼らは一線を越えてしまう。 マーティ役をブラッド・レンフロ、ボビー役をニック・スタールが演じ、マイケル・ピット、レオ・フィッツパトリックら、2000年代初頭のアメリカ映画界を彩った若手俳優たちが顔をそろえた。原作は、ボビー・ケント殺害事件を追ったジム・シュッツのノンフィクション「なぜ、いじめっ子は殺されたのか？」。ドクター・ドレーやソニック・ユースのサーストン・ムーアらの楽曲も使用されている。2001年の公開から25周年を迎える2026年に、4Kで再公開される。
t9517.synopsis_en: After 25 years, revived in 4K. The most dangerous youth film! (R18+) 'BULLY 4K' Larry Clark's shocking work returns to the screen in 4K after 25 years. 'Why was the bully killed?' A youth crime film based on a real murder case, adapted from Jim Schutze's nonfiction book of the same title about the 1993 murder of Bobby Kent in Florida. In the boring suburbs of South Florida, childhood friends Bobby and Marty are bound by a distorted relationship that can hardly be called friendship. Bobby dominates; Marty continues to obey. Into this dynamic come the free-spirited girl Ali and the lonely Lisa. Lisa, who falls in love with Marty, tries to separate him from Bobby. But Ali also learns of Bobby's cruelty, and among the young people, anger and fear quietly swell. 'If only Bobby were gone—' What begins as a joke-like murderous thought draws in the group and eventually becomes a real plan. No one stopped it. No one thought it was serious. And on a boring summer night, they cross a line from which there is no return. Why does youth turn to violence? Where does friendship become domination? Why does love create accomplices? 'BULLY 4K' simultaneously embodies the brilliance of youth films and the coldness of crime films, exposing the violence born of everyday boredom and indifference—one of Larry Clark's most dangerous works. Larry Clark of 'KIDS' teams up with young talents emblematic of the early 2000s. Also noteworthy is the music featuring Eminem, Thurston Moore, and other major artists! Directing is Larry Clark, known for the photo book 'Tulsa' and who shocked the world with his 1995 feature debut 'KIDS.' His authorship, observing young bodies, gazes, desires, and violence without moral distance, is powerfully etched into this work as well. The cast includes Brad Renfro as Marty, Nick Stahl as Bobby, along with Bijou Phillips, Rachel Miner, Michael Pitt, Kelli Garner, and Leo Fitzpatrick—young actors emblematic of early 2000s American cinema. Their raw performances give the story an inescapable tension. The film's music features Dr. Dre feat. Eminem's 'Forgot About Dre,' as well as tracks by Fatboy Slim, Cypress Hill, Daz Dillinger-related songs, and other tracks capturing the atmosphere of US hip-hop/club music around 2000. The soundtrack also includes a track by Sonic Youth's Thurston Moore. The intense musical design, where hip-hop's era-defining sound intersects with noise/avant-garde acoustics, is a major highlight. New visuals and trailer also unveiled for the 4K theatrical release 25 years after production! New visuals and a trailer have been completed for the 4K theatrical release. The new visuals capture the dazzling light of South Florida and imagery evoking the precarious relationships of the young people, conveying the raw pain of youth and unsettling atmosphere characteristic of Larry Clark's work. These visuals impress upon viewers the film's vividness revived in 4K and its dangerous appeal that remains undiminished even years after its release. The trailer depicts the aimless daily lives of young people in the boring suburbs, along with the domination, anger, and murderous intent gradually spreading among them. It condenses the music where hip-hop intersects with an unsettling score, the exposed expressions of the young cast, and the tension hurtling toward an irreversible incident, powerfully conveying the world of 'Bully 4K.' SYNOPSIS: In the suburbs of South Florida. Childhood friends Bobby Kent and Marty Puccio spend all their time together, cycling through boring jobs, drugs, and making pocket money on the streets at night. But their relationship is more than mere friendship. Bobby dominates, insults, and binds Marty with violence. Marty, though hurt, cannot escape the relationship. The two encounter the free-spirited, beautiful girl Ali and her friend Lisa. Lisa, who falls in love with Marty, comes to wish she could save him from Bobby's domination. Meanwhile, Ali, having become involved with Bobby, also witnesses his cruelty and abnormal violence. Love, jealousy, anger, fear. The young people's pent-up emotions swell, and eventually Lisa becomes desperate. If only Bobby were gone, wouldn't everything end?— The murderous thought spoken as a joke gradually draws in the group and becomes a real plan. And on a boring summer night, they cross a line from which there is no return. Based on a real murder case, Larry Clark of 'KIDS' lays bare the pain of youth, desire, domination, and the ordinariness of violence in this shocking work.
t9517.tmdb_overview_en: A group of teenagers in South Florida enact a murder plot against their mutual bully, Bobby, who has emotionally, physically, and sexually abused them for years.

nチャオヤングの墓.synopsis: 劇団「南極」の劇作家・演出家こんにち博士が映画初監督を務め、架空の島をめぐって繰り広げられる冒険を描いたロードムービー。 自然史博物館で働く分類学者・荒須賀南港と、ロケ中のテレビマン・川田鱚太、カウボーイになりたい中学生・比野光とその弟・ぼんべ。大昔の動物の化石が眠る「卵池島」を訪れた彼らは、伝説のカウボーイだったという曽祖父チャオ・ヤングの墓を目指して冒険を繰り広げる。 「椰子の高さ」「すべての夜を思いだす」の大場みなみが荒須賀南港役、NHK大河ドラマ「豊臣兄弟！」の山脇辰哉が川田鱚太役、「おとなになりたくなれますように」の端栞里が比野光役、映画初出演の井田よとが比野ぼんべ役を務め、「本を綴る」の矢柴俊博、「チルド」などで知られる映画監督の岩崎裕介が共演。打楽器奏者・シンガーソングライターの角銅真実が音楽を担当。
nチャオヤングの墓.synopsis_en: Produced by the young theater company Nankyoku, whose new production "War of the Worlds" sold out immediately, this is the directorial debut of Nankyoku's playwright Hakase Konnichi, one of the most exciting forces in the theater scene today. Up-and-coming talents from various genres come together to create a bold new adventure film.

t1169789.movie_title: 私たちは、ちょうどいい。
t1169789.movie_title_jp: 私たちは、ちょうどいい。
t1169789.clean_title_jp: 私たちは、ちょうどいい。
t1169789.director: トレイシー・レイモン
t1169789.synopsis: 疎遠になった父をSNSで探していた女性が、父と同姓同名の見知らぬ男性とかけがえのない友情を育んでいく姿を描いたヒューマンドラマ。本作が長編デビュー作となるトレイシー・レイモンが監督・脚本を手がけ、自身の実体験に着想を得て撮りあげた。 住み込みで友人の介助をしながら暮らすリリー・トレヴィノ。幼い頃に母に捨てられ、父とも疎遠になっていた彼女は、孤独を抱えながら生きていた。そんなある日、電話にも出ない父と連絡を取ろうとSNSで彼を探しはじめたリリーは、父と同姓同名の見知らぬ男性ボブ・トレヴィノに友達申請を送ってしまう。建設会社で働きながら妻ジーニーと支え合って生きてきたボブは心優しく、自分のことよりも相手を優先してしまう性格だった。偶然つながったリリーの孤独に気づいたボブは、彼女にそっと寄り添うようになる。何気ないメッセージのやり取りを重ねていくうちに、リリーとボブの間には少しずつ特別な友情が芽生えはじめる。 テレビドラマ「ユーフォリア EUPHORIA」のバービー・フェレイラがリリー・トレヴィノ、「シェフ　三ツ星フードトラック始めました」のジョン・レグイザモがボブ・トレヴィノを演じた。2024年SXSW（サウス・バイ・サウスウエスト映画祭）で審査員特別賞と観客賞を受賞。
t1169789.synopsis_en: A human drama depicting a woman searching for her estranged father on social media, who instead develops an irreplaceable friendship with a complete stranger sharing her father's exact name. This feature debut by director and screenwriter Tracy Raymond was inspired by her own real-life experiences. Lily Trevino lives as a live-in caregiver for a friend. Abandoned by her mother at a young age and estranged from her father, she lives with loneliness. One day, trying to contact her father who doesn't even answer the phone, she begins searching for him on social media and accidentally sends a friend request to a stranger named Bob Trevino, who shares her father's exact name. Bob, who works at a construction company and lives supporting each other with his wife Jeanie, is kind-hearted and prioritizes others over himself. Noticing Lily's loneliness through their chance connection, Bob gently begins to be there for her. As they exchange casual messages, a special friendship gradually blossoms between Lily and Bob. Barbie Ferreira of the TV series "Euphoria" plays Lily Trevino, and John Leguizamo of "Chef" plays Bob Trevino. The film won the Special Jury Award and the Audience Award at SXSW 2024.
t1169789.tmdb_overview_en: Lily Trevino unexpectedly befriends an online stranger who shares her self-centered father’s name. This new Bob Trevino’s support could transform her life.
t1169789.tmdb_overview_jp: 住み込みで友人の介助をしながら暮らすリリー・トレヴィノ。 幼い頃に母に捨てられ、父とも疎遠になった彼女は、孤独を抱えながら生きていた。ある日、父と連絡を取ろうと SNS で父を探し始めたリリー。だが、父だと思って友達申請を送った相手は、父と同姓同名の見知らぬ男性、ボブ・トレヴィノだった。 ボブは建設会社で働く心優しい男性。妻ジーニーと支え合いながら生きてきた彼は、自分のことよりも相手を優先してしまう性格だった。偶然つながったリリーの孤独に気づいたボブは、彼女にそっと寄り添いはじめる。 何気ないメッセージのやり取りを重ねるうちに、リリーとボブの間には少しずつ特別な友情が芽生えていく。ただの人違いだったはずの出会いは、やがてふたりにとってかけがえのない居場所になっていく――。

nばなにゃ第1期全13話一挙上映.synopsis:
【概要】 『ばなにゃ』はファンシー文具メーカー、株式会社クーリア原案のキャラクターをアニメ化し、2016年にTVシリーズアニメーションとして放送。TVシリーズは第2期まで、配信シリーズとして第3期が制作されており、2026年7月には10周年記念作品として『ばなにゃ あっとほーむぱーてぃー』が各配信サイトにて配信されました。 世界的高級ブランドとのコラボ実績もあるなど海外でも大人気の本作。今後も、タイアップ企画やイベントが続々と予定されています。 声優にはシリーズを通して梶裕貴・村瀬歩を起用、今回上映される第1期では蛭子能収がナレーターを務めています。ばなにゃの可愛らしい鳴き声（？）はもちろん、"ばなにゃ研究者"という設定でばなにゃの生態を紹介する、淡々とした優しく穏やかなナレーションも必聴です。 バナナの中にひそむ不思議な生物、ばなにゃ。映画館という特別な場所で日常を離れて、可愛いばなにゃ達にぜひ癒されてください。 【ばなにゃ　とは？】 バナナの中にひそむ不思議なにゃんこ。 バナナの皮に包まれている部分は誰も見た事がない... 本物のバナナにまぎれて暮らしていて、人がいない時に こっそり遊んだり、いたずらしたりするよ。 甘いお菓子と遊ぶことが大好き♥ 夢はおしゃれな「チョコばなにゃ」になることだよ。 【上映期間】 2026年9月25日（金）～10月1日（木）　1週間限定　※1日1回上映 【料金】 特別料金1000円均一 ※各種招待券、無料券使用不可 【上映時間】 計43分　（1話3分20秒）

nばなにゃ第1期全13話一挙上映.synopsis_en: [Overview] "Bananya" is an anime adaptation of characters originally created by fancy stationery maker Q-Lia Co., Ltd., broadcast as a TV series anime in 2016. The TV series ran through Season 2, and Season 3 was produced as a streaming series. In July 2026, as a 10th anniversary work, "Bananya: At Home Party" was distributed on various streaming sites. This work is hugely popular overseas as well, with collaborations with world-class luxury brands. More tie-in projects and events are planned going forward. Yuki Kaji and Ayumu Murase have been cast throughout the series, and in Season 1 being screened this time, Yoshikazu Ebisu serves as narrator. Of course you can enjoy Bananya's adorable cries (?), but the calm, gentle, and peaceful narration—introducing Bananya's ecology under the setting of a "Bananya researcher"—is also a must-hear. Bananya: mysterious creatures hiding inside bananas. Please leave your daily life behind in the special place that is a movie theater, and let the cute Bananyas heal you. [What is Bananya?] A mysterious kitty hiding inside a banana. No one has ever seen the part wrapped in the banana peel... They live mixed in with real bananas, and when people aren't around, they secretly play and cause mischief. They love playing with sweet treats♥ Their dream is to become a stylish "Choco Bananya." t926606.director: ジェームズ・デモナコ（『パージ』シリーズ）
t926606.synopsis: 全米TOP10入り！『パージ』監督最新作。立ち入り禁止のサイコホラー解禁！ 養兄弟のルークを突然亡くし、悲しみの底で不良行為を繰り返していたグラフィティ・アーティストのマックスは老人ホームの清掃員として働くことで刑務所行きを免れた。 マックスが配属されたのはニューヨーク州北部の深い森にひっそりと佇む穏やかな老人ホーム「グリーン・メドウズ」。 優しい入居者たちに囲まれて、やりがいを感じはじめる彼だったが、夜中に響く悲鳴、入居者の突然の死、そして"特別なケア"が必要とされる入居者が暮らす4階への立ち入りを禁止されたことから不信感を抱き、潜入を試みるのだが......。
t926606.synopsis_en: Top 10 in the US! The latest film from the director of "The Purge." A forbidden psycho-horror unleashed! Graffiti artist Max, who lost her foster brother Luke suddenly and had been acting out in the depths of grief, avoided a prison sentence by working as a cleaner at a nursing home. Max was assigned to "Green Meadows," a peaceful nursing home quietly nestled in the deep woods of upstate New York. Surrounded by gentle residents, she begins to feel a sense of purpose, but she grows suspicious due to screams echoing in the night, the sudden deaths of residents, and being forbidden from entering the fourth floor where residents requiring "special care" live, so she attempts to sneak in, but...
t926606.tmdb_overview_en: A troubled man starts working at a retirement home and realizes its residents and caretakers harbor sinister secrets. As he investigates the building and its forbidden fourth floor, he starts to uncover connections to his own past and upbringing as a foster child.

t1160360.movie_title_en: If I Had Legs I’d Kick You
t1160360.movie_title_original: If I Had Legs I'd Kick You
t1160360.director: メアリー・ブロンスタイン
t1160360.synopsis: 本来は複数人で担うべき育児や家事、仕事を1人で背負う「ワンオペレーション」という現代の社会問題を題材に、追い詰められた主人公の日常とアイデンティティーが崩壊していく様子を没入感たっぷりに描いたドラマ。 原因不明の病を抱える幼い娘の世話をしながらセラピストとして働くリンダは、顧客の患者への対応や、娘の担当医からの叱責、長期出張中の口うるさい夫からの電話など、息つく暇もない日々を送っていた。そんな中、自宅アパートの天井が突然崩落し、娘とともに海辺の格安モーテルで暮らすことを余儀なくされる。誰にも頼れない孤独な状況のなかでついに限界を迎えた彼女は、思いもよらない事態にのみ込まれていく。 「ブライズメイズ　史上最悪のウェディングプラン」などのローズ・バーンが主人公リンダを鬼気迫る演技で体現し、2025年・第75回ベルリン国際映画祭で最優秀主演俳優賞（銀熊賞）、2026年・第83回ゴールデングローブ賞で最優秀主演女優賞（ミュージカル／コメディ部門）を受賞、第98回アカデミー賞で主演女優賞にノミネートされた。心理学の修士号を持つメアリー・ブロンスタイン監督が、重病の娘とモーテルで暮らした自身の実体験をもとに脚本を執筆し、生々しい現実感とブラックユーモアを織り交ぜた独創的な映像表現で描き出す。
t1160360.synopsis_en: A shocking work from A24 that cuts into the "one-operation problem" afflicting modern people! A shocking work born from the director's own experiences, depicting a daily life on the verge of collapse! Produced by A24, the cutting-edge studio behind numerous talked-about films such as "Midsommar" and "Everything Everywhere All at Once." This shocking work depicts the structural problem of modern society known as "one-operation"—where childcare, housework, and work that should be shared among multiple people are shouldered by one person alone—as an unpredictable story blending thriller, psychological drama, and dark comedy, forcing viewers to relive the nightmare of the protagonist's daily life and identity collapsing. Linda, overwhelmed by housework, childcare, and her work as a therapist, is driven to the brink caring for her young daughter who suffers from an unexplained illness. Between responding to her client patients, being reprimanded by her daughter's doctor, and phone calls from her nagging husband who is away on business—with no moment of rest—the ceiling of her apartment suddenly collapses, and she moves with her daughter to a cheap seaside motel. Having reached her limit in isolation with no one to rely on, she is swallowed by an unforeseen situation—
t1160360.tmdb_overview_en: With her life crashing down around her, Linda attempts to navigate her child's mysterious illness, her absent husband, a missing person, and an increasingly hostile relationship with her therapist.

genres: サイエンスフィクション
t1496928.synopsis: 「ピーピロリロリロ。地球での極秘任務完了。宇宙へ帰還します！」 平成のある田舎町 内気で"普通"であることに悩む少年・翼は、 小学三年生の春、 クラスの人気者で"特別"な存在の暁太郎と出会い、親友になる 二人だけの遊び、意味のない会話、夕暮れの帰り道------ 世界は確かに、彼らのものだった しかしある日を境に、暁太郎はクラスの中で浮いた存在となり、 噂や視線が彼を囲んでいく やがて起こる、取り返しのつかない事件 「もしもさ、俺が宇宙人だったらどうする？」 これは二人の青春物語なのか それとも消したい記憶なのか 30年にわたる友情を描いた、 かぎりなく青い旅立ちの物語------
t1496928.synopsis_en: "Pipiro rirori ro. Secret mission on Earth complete. Returning to space!" In a certain rural town in the Heisei era, Tsubasa, a shy boy troubled by being "ordinary," meets Akitaro, the class idol and a "special" presence, in the spring of his third year of elementary school, and they become best friends. Games just for the two of them, meaningless conversations, the walk home at dusk—— The world was certainly theirs. But from a certain day onward, Akitaro became an outcast in the class, and rumors and stares surrounded him. Eventually, an irreversible incident occurs. "Hey, what would you do if I were an alien?" Is this a coming-of-age story of two people, or a memory they want to erase? A story of a friendship spanning 30 years, an endlessly blue tale of departure——
t1496928.tmdb_overview_en: One summer in the third grade, a quiet boy named Tsubasa meets Gyotaro, a boy everyone in the class looked up to, and the two become close friends. Within their small world, they share irreplaceable moments—until a small incident suddenly tears them apart.
t1496928.tmdb_overview_jp: 小学三年生の夏、内気な少年のつばさは、クラスの人気者である暁太郎と出会い、親友になる。小さな世界の中で、かけがえのない時間を過ごしていくふたり。しかし、ある些細な事件をきっかけに、ふたりの関係は引き裂かれて——。  30年以上にわたる少年たちの友情と再会を通して、人が生きることの意味を静かに問いかける物語。

t1704357.movie_title: 温泉シャーク2 九州大決戦
t1704357.movie_title_jp: 温泉シャーク2 九州大決戦
t1704357.movie_title_en: Hot Spring Shark Attack 2: Great Kyushu Showdown
t1704357.clean_title_jp: 温泉シャーク2九州大決戦
t1704357.movie_title_original: 温泉シャーク2九州大決戦
t1704357.synopsis: 人々の癒やしの場である温泉に突如として凶暴なサメが出現するという奇想天外な設定で話題を集めた日本発のサメ映画「温泉シャーク」の続編。熊本県小国町をはじめ九州各地でロケを敢行し、九州全土を巻き込んだ壮絶なバトルを描き出す。 古くから「サメ太郎」伝説が語り継がれてきたK県湯国町では、町内の至るところにサメをまつる意匠が残され、恐ろしいサメを退治した英雄の記憶を留めている。しかし暑海市で起きた「温泉シャーク騒動」の影響により、湯国町でも観光客が減少し、すっかり活気が失われていた。ミュージシャンを夢見る女子高生の速見天満は、ある夜、地元に伝わる大切な「サメ太郎像」を誤って壊してしまう。その直後、観光客が行方不明になる事件が発生し……。 「空（カラ）の味」の柴田瑠歌が速見天満役で主演を務め、天満の祖父を勝野洋が演じる。共演には金子清文、内藤正記ら前作のキャストが再結集し、前作で観客の理解を超えた存在として話題となったキャラクター「マッチョ」も再登場。現代美術界隈で活動するコントユニット「そんたくズ」の井上森人が前作に引き続き監督・脚本を手がけた。
t1704357.synopsis_en: The sequel to the Japanese shark film "Onsen Shark," which gained attention for its bizarre premise of ferocious sharks suddenly appearing in hot springs, a place of healing for people. Filming took place across Kyushu, including in Oguni Town, Kumamoto Prefecture, depicting a fierce battle that engulfs the entire Kyushu region. In Yugo Town, K Prefecture, where the legend of "Shark Taro" has been passed down since ancient times, shrines and designs dedicated to sharks remain throughout the town, preserving the memory of a hero who vanquished the terrifying shark. However, due to the influence of the "Onsen Shark Incident" in Atsumi City, tourist numbers in Yugo Town have declined, and the town has lost its vitality. Hayami Tema, a high school girl dreaming of becoming a musician, accidentally breaks the town's treasured "Shark Taro statue" one night. Shortly after, an incident occurs where a tourist goes missing... Ruka Shibata of "The Taste of Sky" stars as Hayami Tema, with Yo Katsuno playing Tema's grandfather. The cast also reunites actors from the previous film, including Kiyofumi Kaneko and Masaki Naito, and the character "Macho," who became a topic of discussion in the previous film as an existence beyond audience comprehension, also returns. Morito Inoue of the comedy unit "Sontaku's," active in the contemporary art scene, wrote and directed the film again.
t1704357.tmdb_overview_en: A massive swarm of clone sharks rises from hot springs and volcanoes, leading to a jaw-dropping showdown that throws all of Kyushu into total chaos! The story follows a high school girl and her bond with an Onsen Shark.

t9464.synopsis: 俳優・ミュージシャン・画家など多彩な活動で知られるビンセント・ギャロが初監督・脚本・音楽・主演を務めたオフビートなラブストーリー。1991年・第25回スーパーボウルの勝敗をプロットに盛り込みながら、ダメ男だがなぜか憎めない主人公の人生模様と、彼の全てを優しく受け止めようとする少女を描く。5年の刑期を終えて出所したビリーは、故郷の街バッファローへ帰ることに。事情を知らない両親に電話して「婚約者を連れて行く」と嘘をついてしまった彼は、見ず知らずの少女レイラを拉致して恋人のふりをするよう強要。レイラはビリーと一緒に過ごすうちに彼の孤独な素顔を知り、次第に好意を抱き始める。しかし、ビリーにはやり残したことがあった。レイラ役に「アダムス・ファミリー」のクリスティーナ・リッチ。日本では1999年7月に渋谷シネクイントのオープニング作品として初公開（キネティック配給）。当時の渋谷を中心としたミニシアターブームの中で大ヒットとなり、34週にわたるロングランを記録した。2021年1月、渋谷ホワイトシネクイントで約20年ぶりのリバイバル公開（コピアポア・フィルム配給）。
t9464.synopsis_en: Billy is released from prison after serving a five-year sentence. Having been away from home for work and having lied to his parents that he was married, he kidnaps a passing woman named Layla on his way back to his family home... <A love story that shot Vincent Gallo to stardom. It depicts the taciturn love between an anarchic man who knows nothing of love and a woman drawn to him. The gray-toned visuals and unique slow pacing make for an unparalleled artistic style. Co-starring Christina Ricci.>
t9464.tmdb_overview_en: Billy is released after five years in prison. In the next moment, he kidnaps teenage student Layla and visits his parents with her, pretending she is his girlfriend and they will soon marry.
t9464.tmdb_overview_jp: 5年の刑期を経て出所してきたビリー。仕事で家を離れ、両親に結婚したと偽っていた彼は、実家に戻るため通りすがりの女・レイラを拉致する……。＜ヴィンセント・ギャロを一躍スターダムに押し上げたラブ・ストーリー。愛を知らないアナーキーな男と、彼に惹かれる女の寡黙な愛を描く。グレーを基調にしたビジュアルや独特のスロー描写など、他に類を見ないアーティスティックな作風が見もの。共演にクリスティーナ・リッチ。＞

t1425485.tmdb_overview_en: Despite the close bonds among fellow defectors, Cheol-jun—a young North Korean defector—felt isolated while hiding his gay identity. Finally, he takes his first step into South Korea's vibrant gay community and forms close ties after meeting Yeong-jun at a casual gathering. Yet, a trivial misunderstanding shatters these fragile bonds.

t936075.director: アントワン・フークア
t936075.synopsis: 圧倒的な歌唱力と革新的なダンスパフォーマンスで時代や国境を越えて愛され続ける「キング・オブ・ポップ」ことマイケル・ジャクソンの人生を描いた伝記映画。「トレーニング デイ」「イコライザー」シリーズのアントワン・フークア監督がメガホンをとり、音楽の枠を超えて世界に多大な影響を与えたマイケルの物語を、数々の名曲と共に描き出す。 野心家の父ジョセフのもとで厳しいレッスンを受け、兄弟グループ「ジャクソン5」のメンバーとして幼くして成功を収めたマイケル・ジャクソン。やがて名プロデューサーのクインシー・ジョーンズと出会った彼は、ソロアーティストとして数々の歴史的名曲を生み出し、瞬く間に時代の寵児となっていく。しかしその栄光の裏には、早熟の天才ゆえの孤独感や、強権的な父の呪縛、家族への愛と自分の中にあふれるビジョンとの間で葛藤するひとりの人間の姿があった。 主演にはマイケルの実の甥であるジャファー・ジャクソンを抜てきし、幼少期のマイケルをジュリアーノ・クルー・バルディ、父ジョセフをコールマン・ドミンゴ、母キャサリンをニア・ロング、音楽プロデューサーのクインシー・ジョーンズをケンドリック・サンプソン、長年の弁護士ジョン・ブランカをマイルズ・テラーが演じた。「グラディエーター」のジョン・ローガンが脚本を手がけ、製作には「ボヘミアン・ラプソディ」のグレアム・キングが名を連ねる。
t936075.synopsis_en: A biographical film depicting the life of Michael Jackson, the "King of Pop," beloved across eras and borders for his overwhelming vocal ability and innovative dance performances. Directed by Antoine Fuqua of "Training Day" and "The Equalizer" series, it portrays Michael's story—how he transcended music to greatly impact the world—alongside his many hit songs. Michael Jackson, under his ambitious father Joseph's strict training, achieved early success as a member of the Jackson 5. Meeting legendary producer Quincy Jones, he created numerous historic hits as a solo artist and quickly became the darling of his era. But behind the glory lay the loneliness of a precocious genius, the shackles of his authoritarian father, and the struggle between his love for his family and the visions overflowing within him. The film stars Michael's real-life nephew Jaafar Jackson as Michael, with Juliano Krue Valdi as young Michael, Colman Domingo as father Joseph, Nia Long as mother Katherine, Kendrick Sampson as Quincy Jones, and Miles Teller as longtime lawyer John Branca. The screenplay was written by John Logan of "Gladiator," and the film was produced by Graham King of "Bohemian Rhapsody."
t936075.tmdb_overview_en: The story of Michael Jackson, one of the most influential artists the world has ever known, and his life beyond the music. His journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fueled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world, highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career.
t936075.tmdb_overview_jp: 圧倒的な歌唱力と革新的なダンスパフォーマンスで、アーティストの枠を超え、全世界的なアイコンとなった“キング・オブ・ポップ”＝マイケル・ジャクソン。彼は幼いころから兄弟と共に歌い続けていた。製鉄所で働く父・ジョセフは野心家で、「人生は勝つか負けるかだ」と言い放ち、息子たちに厳しいレッスンを課し、兄弟グループ“ジャクソン５”としてデビューさせた。彼らをみた聴衆は誰しもマイケルの圧倒的な歌声に酔いしれた。評判は広まり、ステージからステージへ人気は急上昇、モータウン・レコードと契約し、スターダムを駆け上がっていく。しかし、喝采の裏で彼はまだ一人の少年だった。孤独と重圧の中、唯一無条件の愛で支え続けたのが母・キャサリンだった。やがて青年となったマイケルに運命の出会いが訪れる。音楽史にその名を刻む名プロデューサー、クインシー・ジョーンズ。彼との出会いによってマイケルはグループの枠を超え、ソロアーティストとして前人未踏の音楽的創造性を爆発させていく。『オフ・ザ・ウォール』『スリラー』、歴史的メガヒットアルバムと名曲の数々を生み出し、全世界の寵児となっていくマイケル。しかし、その栄光の裏には、早熟の天才ゆえの孤独感、強権的な父親の呪縛、家族への愛と自分の中に溢れるビジョンとの間で葛藤する一人の人間の姿があった… そして今、音楽史を塗り替える存在——“キング・オブ・ポップ”伝説誕生の瞬間へ。

n100万カットの記憶.synopsis: 水俣病の記録で知られる報道写真家・桑原史成の生きざまを追った、韓国発のドキュメンタリー。 1962年に水俣を撮影した作品で報道写真家としてデビューした桑原史成は、水俣病の被害者たちに長期的に寄り添い、被写体と深い関係性を築きながら、人間の尊厳と記憶を写し出す仕事を60年以上にわたり続けてきた。政治、公害、分断といった主題に真正面から向き合い、2014年には土門拳賞を受賞。同時代の記録者として、後進に多大な影響を与えてきた。その活動は日本のみならず、日韓国交正常化前夜の1964年に韓国へ渡り、市井の人々の姿をとらえた写真群が、その後の代表作「水俣・韓国・ベトナム」などに結実。それ以降も、南北朝鮮の双方に足を運ぶという希有な経験を通して、分断国家の現実を一貫してカメラに収め続け、韓国においても彼の写真は重要な歴史的記録として高く評価されている。 本作では、桑原を長年にわたり支えるパートナーの和子ら関係者のインタビューなどを通してその人物像に迫るとともに、高齢となった桑原が健康状態を心配されながらも、人生をかけて撮り続けた韓国を再訪しようとする姿を映し出す。監督は「ムルスム（水の息）」「プルスム（炎の息）」などを手がけた韓国のドキュメンタリー作家コ・ヒヨン。
n100万カットの記憶.synopsis_en: A South Korean documentary tracing the life of Fumifumi Kuwabara, a photojournalist known for his documentation of Minamata disease. Kuwabara debuted as a photojournalist in 1962 with his photographs of Minamata, and for over 60 years he has remained close to the victims of Minamata disease, building deep relationships with his subjects while capturing human dignity and memory. He has confronted themes of politics, pollution, and division head-on, and received the Domon Ken Award in 2014. As a chronicler of his era, he has had a profound influence on younger generations. His work extends beyond Japan; in 1964, on the eve of Japan-South Korea normalization, he traveled to South Korea, and his photographs of ordinary people there culminated in his representative works such as "Minamata, Korea, Vietnam." Since then, through the rare experience of visiting both North and South Korea, he has consistently documented the reality of the divided nation, and his photographs are highly regarded as important historical records in South Korea as well. This film explores his character through interviews with his long-time partner Kazuko and others close to him, while also depicting the elderly Kuwabara, despite concerns about his health, attempting to revisit South Korea, the country he spent his life photographing. Directed by South Korean documentary filmmaker Ko Hiyoung, known for "Mulsum (Breath of Water)" and "Pulsum (Breath of Fire)."

n軍服を着た神様.synopsis: 台湾各地に存在する「日本人の神様」の謎を追ったドキュメンタリー。 かつて日本が植民地として統治していた台湾には、軍服を着た日本人が神様として祀られている場所が50カ所以上もあるという。文化人類学者の藤野陽平と記録映像作家の遠藤協が、台湾各地の「日本神（にほんがみ）」を訪ね歩く旅を、コロナ禍を挟んで足かけ6年にわたって記録。謎をたどっていくうちに、日本神がそれぞれひとりの人間として確かに存在した事実が明らかになり、彼らの数奇な運命と、台湾の民間信仰のあり方、そして日本が台湾に残してきた戦争の痕跡が浮かび上がる。異国の地でさまよい死後の世界を生きる日本人の魂と、その魂を慰撫し神として祀る台湾の人々、神となった先祖と出会いなおす日本の子孫たちの姿を通し、死者を悼み弔う心が生んだ、日本と台湾の知られざる交流を描き出す。 監督は民俗学的なモチーフを得意とし、「廻り神楽」で第73回毎日映画コンクールドキュメンタリー映画賞を受賞した遠藤協。音楽ユニット「馬喰町バンド」のメンバーで美術家としても活動する武徹太郎が音楽とアニメーションを手がけた。
n軍服を着た神様.synopsis_en: A documentary exploring the mystery of "Japanese gods" found across Taiwan. In Taiwan, once a Japanese colony, there are over fifty locations where Japanese men in military uniforms are enshrined as deities. Cultural anthropologist Yohei Fujino and documentary filmmaker Kyo Endo spent six years, including the COVID-19 pandemic, traveling across Taiwan to visit these "Japanese gods." As they trace the mystery, the fact that each Japanese god truly existed as an individual human being comes to light, revealing their extraordinary fates, the nature of Taiwanese folk beliefs, and the lingering traces of war Japan left in Taiwan. Through the souls of Japanese people wandering in a foreign land after death, the Taiwanese who soothe these souls and enshrine them as gods, and the Japanese descendants who reconnect with their deified ancestors, the film portrays an unknown exchange between Japan and Taiwan born from the heart of mourning and honoring the dead. Directed by Kyo Endo, who specializes in folkloric motifs and won the 73rd Mainichi Film Award for Best Documentary for "Meguri Kagura." Music and animation are by Tetsutaro Take, a member of the music unit "Bakurocho Band" who also works as an artist.

t1631314.synopsis: 「サマータイムマシン・ブルース」「リバー、流れないでよ」など数々の話題作で映画脚本を手がけてきた劇団「ヨーロッパ企画」代表の上田誠が長編初監督を務め、下北沢にある実在のビル「シェルボ下北沢」を舞台に斬新なギミックで描いた青春コメディ。 「シェルボ下北沢」の2階にある映画館・トリウッド。下北沢の劇作家・マドカと三軒茶屋のバンドマン・カズマはそれぞれ映画を見に行くが、互いの出来事が映画としてスクリーンに映し出されるという、ありえない構造が生まれてしまう。そんな中、映画館の両隣の店「グッドヘブンズ」と「三日月ロック」で問題が発生。マドカとカズマはこの構造を利用しながら問題の解決に挑むが、互いの映画は影響し合い、事態は予想外の方向へと展開していく。 劇作家のマドカ役で「サマーフィルムにのって」の伊藤万理華、バンドマンのカズマ役で「ミュジコフィリア」の井之脇海がそれぞれ主演を務め、マドカが主宰する劇団の団員役で前田旺志郎と菊池日菜子、カズマのバンドのメンバー役で金子鈴幸と三河悠冴、「三日月ロック」に出入りする半グレ役で今井隆文、刑事コンビ役でお笑いコンビ「ザ・ギース」が共演。さらに、石田剛太、金丸慎太郎、藤谷理子らヨーロッパ企画のメンバーが個性的なキャラクターたちを演じる。
t1631314.synopsis_en: A youth comedy directed by Makoto Ueda, head of the theater group "Europe Kikaku," known for writing screenplays for numerous hit films like "Summer Time Machine Blues" and "River, Don't Flow On." This is his feature directorial debut, set in the real-life building "Shelbo Shimokitazawa" in Shimokitazawa, employing innovative gimmicks. At the cinema Tollywood on the second floor of "Shelbo Shimokitazawa," Madoka, a playwright from Shimokitazawa, and Kazuma, a band musician from Sangenjaya, each go to see a movie. An impossible structure emerges where each other's events are projected onto the screen as a film. Meanwhile, problems arise at the shops adjacent to the cinema, "Good Heavens" and "Mikazuki Rock." Madoka and Kazuma try to solve the problems using this structure, but their films influence each other, and the situation spirals in unexpected directions. Starring Maria Ito ("Summer Film ni Notte") as Madoka the playwright and Kai Inowaki ("Musicophilia") as Kazuma the band musician. The cast also includes Oshiro Maeda and Hinako Kikuchi as members of Madoka's theater troupe, Suzuyuki Kaneko and Yusuke Mikawa as members of Kazuma's band, Takafumi Imai as a semi-delinquent who frequents "Mikazuki Rock," and the comedy duo "The Geese" as a pair of detectives. Additionally, members of Europe Kikaku, including Gota Ishida, Shintaro Kanamaru, and Riko Fujitani, play unique characters.
t1631314.tmdb_overview_en: The directorial debut of Makoto Ueda, the award-winning writer of such films as Beyond the Infinite Two Minutes, River, Night is Short Walk on Girl, etc

t1715073.synopsis: 日本における外国人への差別と迫害を見つめ、平和と共生について考えるドキュメンタリー。現在の入管庁の難民認定制度・強制送還の問題と、百年前の関東大震災時に起きた朝鮮人虐殺を通して、日本の植民地主義について問い直す。 2023年、日本の国会では、政府による難民認定をさらに厳格化しようという法改正が議論を呼んでいた。不認定となった者が収容される入管施設では死者も出ており、その環境は長年にわたり問題視されている。この現状を変えようと、多くの市民が声を上げはじめた。一方、1923年には関東大震災の混乱のなかで、警察や自警団が朝鮮人や中国人を虐殺する事件が起きたが、日本政府は現在もこの問題を公式に認めていない。 映画では、難民支援を続けるアクティビストや、仮放免中の当事者、朝鮮人虐殺の証言を継承する市民グループやドキュメンタリー監督、研究者など、さまざまな立場の人たちにカメラを向け、「過去の虐殺と現在の入管問題は、いまだ精算されていない“植民地主義”でつながっている」という事実を浮かび上がらせていく。監督は「百年と希望」「わたしの自由について」の西原孝至。
t1715073.synopsis_en: A documentary that examines discrimination and persecution against foreigners in Japan, and contemplates peace and coexistence. It reconsiders Japanese colonialism through the current Immigration Services Agency's refugee recognition system and forced deportation issues, as well as the massacre of Koreans that occurred during the Great Kanto Earthquake a hundred years ago. In 2023, a legislative amendment to further tighten the government's refugee recognition was debated in Japan's National Diet. Deaths have occurred at immigration facilities where those not recognized are detained, and the conditions there have been criticized for years. Many citizens have begun to raise their voices to change this situation. Meanwhile, in 1923, amid the chaos of the Great Kanto Earthquake, police and vigilante groups massacred Koreans and Chinese, but the Japanese government still does not officially acknowledge this issue. The film turns its camera on activists supporting refugees, individuals currently on temporary release, citizen groups and documentary filmmakers preserving testimonies of the Korean massacre, and researchers from various positions, bringing to light the fact that 'the past massacre and the current immigration detention problem are connected by an unsettled colonialism.' Directed by Takashi Nishihara of '100 Years of Hope' and 'About My Freedom.'
t1715073.tmdb_overview_en: A college student, along with her peers in Japan, rally to change the country’s hostile immigration laws that have incarcerated asylum-seekers in deadly detention centers. Meanwhile, over a century since the 1923 massacre of Korean people during a massive earthquake in Imperial Japan, young activists today take on the torch to seek justice under a government that continues to deny this history. A filmmaker documenting these young activists on the ground begins to excavate the underlying history of discrimination that connects the massacre of a hundred years ago and the draconian refugee system in Japan. Through the process of listening to voices from the past and present, the landscapes in Tokyo begin to echo the unfinished business of the nation’s reckoning with its colonial history.

t1208284.movie_title: ハルバーシュタットの埋蔵金
t1208284.movie_title_jp: ハルバーシュタットの埋蔵金
t1208284.clean_title_jp: ハルバーシュタットの埋蔵金
t1208284.director: ナーチャ・ブルンクホルスト
t1208284.synopsis: 自由と混乱が交錯する統一前夜の東ドイツを舞台に描いた社会派コメディ。 1990年の夏、東ドイツで暮らす幼なじみのマーレン、ロベルト、フォルカーは、旧体制下で廃棄されるはずだった大量の紙幣が残された地下坑道を発見する。貨幣価値を失った金を手にした彼らは、仲間たちと協力して物質と交換する独自の流通網を築き上げていく。西側資本主義に小さな反旗を翻すその行動は、やがて大きな冒険へと発展していく。 「落下の解剖学」「関心領域」のザンドラ・ヒュラーがマーレン、「マトリックス　レザレクションズ」のマックス・リーメルトがロベルト、「アイヒマンを追え！　ナチスがもっとも畏れた男」のロナルト・ツェアフェルトがフォルカーを演じた。監督・脚本は、「クリスチーネ・F」の主演や「ネレ＆キャプテン　壁をこえて」の脚本などで知られるナーチャ・ブルンクホルスト。日本では、ザンドラ・ヒュラーの出演作を集めた特集上映企画「特集　ザンドラ・ヒュラー　変幻する＜わたし＞のかたち」（2025年10月3日～、YEBISU GARDEN CINEMA）にて「二対一　東ドイツ通貨統一の夏に発見した大切なこと」のタイトルで劇場初公開。2026年9月には「ハルバーシュタットの埋蔵金」の邦題で劇場公開。
t1208284.synopsis_en: A social comedy set in East Germany on the eve of reunification, where freedom and chaos intermingle. In the summer of 1990, childhood friends Maren, Robert, and Volker, living in East Germany, discover an underground tunnel filled with vast amounts of banknotes that were supposed to be discarded under the old regime. With this now-worthless currency in hand, they work with their friends to build their own distribution network, exchanging the money for goods. Their act of small rebellion against Western capitalism eventually develops into a grand adventure. Sandra Hüller ("Anatomy of a Fall," "The Zone of Interest") plays Maren, Max Riemelt ("The Matrix Resurrections") plays Robert, and Ronald Zehrfeld ("The People vs. Fritz Bauer") plays Volker. The director and screenwriter is Natja Brunckhorst, known for starring in "Christiane F." and writing "Nelly & Nadine" and "Beyond the Wall." In Japan, the film had its theatrical premiere under the title "Two Against One: The Precious Things Discovered in the Summer of East German Currency Unification" as part of the special screening series "Sandra Hüller: Shapes of the Transforming Self" (from October 3, 2025, at YEBISU GARDEN CINEMA). It will receive a theatrical release in September 2026 under the Japanese title "Halberstadt's Buried Treasure."
t1208284.tmdb_overview_en: After the fall of the Berlin Wall, a communist family discovers a bunker full of money soon to be worthless. With the help of their neighbors, they embark on a race against time to enter the capitalist world in style.

t1448971.synopsis_en: Yoriko carves sculptures alone from wood cut from a nearby mountain. One day, Yuri, who has been active as an architect in Tokyo and Taiwan, takes a few days off to visit Yoriko, the sister of her ex-husband. Life in the countryside, with its "calm" not found in the city, unfolds gently. Encounters with Yoshihiro, Yoriko's childhood friend who lost his wife, and his son Haruki and Haruki's best friend Keita, bring small ripples to everyday life. Eventually, as she serves as the model for his sculptures every night, Yuri touches upon Yoriko's hidden loss, and changes begin to take place within her as well.
t1448971.tmdb_overview_en: Yoriko, an artist living in rural Nagi, is haunted by a former love affair she cannot bear to mourn. When Yuri, a recently separated architect, travels from Tokyo to visit her friend and former sister-in-law, both women find themselves at a crossroad, each searching for ways to let go of the past and define their identities. Yuri's brief escape from the city settles into a quiet confrontation of loss and probing for the two women in bucolic Nagi.
t1448971.tmdb_overview_jp: 近くの山から切り出される木でひとり彫刻を作る寄子。ある日、東京と台湾で建築家として活躍してきた友梨は、 数日間の休暇をとって、別れた夫の姉・寄子のもとを訪れる。都会にはない「ナギ」での穏やかな生活。妻を亡くした寄子の幼なじみの好浩、そして息子の春樹とその親友の圭太――人々との出会いは、日常に小さな揺らぎをもたらしていく。  やがて、彫刻のモデルを毎晩つとめるなかで寄子の知られざる喪失に触れ、友梨にも変化が起きていく。

nケルトユートピア.synopsis: 音楽があふれる島・アイルランドの過去と現在の姿を、ミュージシャンや市井の人々の視点からとらえたドキュメンタリー。 アイルランドがイギリスから部分的な独立を果たしてから100年。国境で南北に分断され、激動の歴史のなかで生きてきたこの島の人々は、ユーモアと皮肉を交えながら、自由への抵抗や日々の悲哀を美しい旋律に乗せて歌い継いできた。今なお植民地時代の影が残るアイルランドでは、フォーク・リバイバルと呼ばれる新たなムーブメントが起きている。その担い手となっているのは、アイリッシュ・フォークの伝統を受け継ぎながら、R&Bやヒップホップ、パンクなど多様なジャンルから影響を受けた新しい世代のミュージシャンたち。現代的な感覚で祖国に向き合う彼らは、社会の矛盾を鋭く突きながら、未来への希望を歌う。 ザ・メリー・ワロパーズ、ランクム、ザ・デッドリアンズといったバンドや、ラッパーのヤング・スペンサーらが出演。人々の心に響く多様で豊かな音楽に、ポストコロニアル時代のアーカイブ映像を交えながら、歴史の傷跡に向き合うアイルランドの現在を浮かび上がらせていく。2025年・第78回ロカルノ国際映画祭の批評家週間でグランプリを受賞した。
nケルトユートピア.synopsis_en: A documentary capturing the past and present of Ireland, an island overflowing with music, from the perspectives of musicians and ordinary people. 100 years have passed since Ireland achieved partial independence from Britain. Divided north and south by a border, the people of this island, who have lived through a turbulent history, have sung of their resistance to oppression and the sorrows of daily life in beautiful melodies, laced with humor and irony. In Ireland, where the shadows of the colonial era still linger, a new movement called the folk revival is emerging. At its forefront are a new generation of musicians who, while inheriting the Irish folk tradition, are influenced by diverse genres such as R&B, hip-hop, and punk. Facing their homeland with a modern sensibility, they sharply critique society's contradictions while singing of hope for the future. Featuring bands like The Mary Wallopers, Lankum, and The Deadlians, as well as rapper Young Spencer. Interweaving archive footage from the post-colonial era with diverse, rich music that resonates with people, the film brings to light Ireland's present as it confronts the scars of history. Winner of the Grand Prix at the 78th Locarno International Film Festival's Critics Week in 2025.

t106219.director: ウルリケ・オッティンガー
t106219.synopsis: 2020年ベルリン国際映画祭でベルリナーレカメラ（功労賞）を受賞したドイツの映画作家ウルリケ・オッティンガーが1970年代末から80年代にかけて発表した「ベルリン3部作」の第1作。1980年代の西ドイツでアート＆ファッションのアイコン的存在であったタベア・ブルーメンシャインを主演に迎え、酒飲みの女の人生を描き出す。 共演にはパンク歌手のニナ・ハーゲン、「アルファヴィル」のエディ・コンスタンティーヌ、前衛的な芸術運動「Fluxus（フルクサス）」に参加したウルフ・ボステル、戦後ドイツを代表する芸術家マーティン・キッペンバーガーら多彩なキャストが集結。ブルーメンシャインが衣装も担当した。 日本では2023年8月に劇場初公開。
t106219.synopsis_en: The first installment of the "Berlin Trilogy" that German filmmaker Ulrike Ottinger, who received the Berlinale Camera (Honorary Award) at the 2020 Berlin International Film Festival, released from the late 1970s through the 1980s. Starring Tabea Blumenschein, an art and fashion icon in 1980s West Germany, it depicts the life of a heavy-drinking woman. The cast brings together a diverse ensemble including punk singer Nina Hagen, Eddie Constantine of "Alphaville," Wolf Vostell who participated in the avant-garde art movement "Fluxus," and Martin Kippenberger, a leading artist of postwar Germany. Blumenschein also handled the costumes. It was released theatrically in Japan for the first time in August 2023.
t106219.tmdb_overview_en: A sartorially resplendent woman of few words arrives in Berlin with plans to live out the rest of her days as a drunkard.

t54852.movie_title: ザ・ゴールドディガーズ
t54852.movie_title_jp: ザ・ゴールドディガーズ
genres: サイエンスフィクション
t54852.synopsis: 「オルランド」「タンゴ・レッスン」などで知られるイギリスの女性監督サリー・ポッターが1983年に手がけた長編デビュー作。1980年代初頭のロンドンを舞台に、スター女優と銀行員の女性の姿を通して「女性と労働」を独創的なアプローチで描いた作品で、近年ではフェミニズム映画の金字塔として評価が高まっている。 ロンドン中心部に位置する地区「シティ」の銀行でデータ入力係として働く黒人のフランス人女性セレステは、数字を移動するだけの労働の空虚さに疑念を抱き、金と権力の関係に強い関心を抱くようになる。一方、女優のルビーは自らの幼少期の記憶と覆い隠されてきた自分自身の歴史をたどり、“偶像”としての自分を客観的に見つめ直す。やがて出会い言葉を交わしたふたりは、男性の経済的覇権争いと「神秘的でいて無力で美しい」という理想的な女性像とのあいだに、何らかの結びつきがあるのではないかと感じはじめる。 「ダーリング」でアカデミー主演女優賞を受賞したジュリー・クリスティが主演を務め、映画に囚われた女性像を体現するルビーを存在感たっぷりに演じた。ポッター監督と音楽家のリンジー・クーパー、パフォーマンス・アートの先駆者ローズ・イングリッシュが共同で脚本を手がけ、クーパーが音楽、イングリッシュが美術と衣装も担当。日本では2026年8月に劇場初公開。
t54852.synopsis_en: The feature-length debut by British director Sally Potter, known for 'Orlando' and 'The Tango Lesson,' made in 1983. Set in early 1980s London, this film portrays 'women and labor' through a star actress and a female bank clerk with an original approach, and in recent years has gained recognition as a landmark of feminist cinema. Celeste, a Black French woman working as a data entry clerk at a bank in the City of London, begins to question the emptiness of her work moving numbers and develops a strong interest in the relationship between money and power. Meanwhile, Ruby, an actress, traces her childhood memories and her own obscured history, objectively re-examining herself as an 'icon.' When the two meet and converse, they begin to sense a connection between men's economic power struggles and the idealized image of women as 'mysterious, powerless, and beautiful.' Julie Christie, who won the Academy Award for Best Actress for 'Darling,' stars, delivering a commanding performance as Ruby, embodying the image of women trapped in film. Potter co-wrote the script with musician Lindsay Cooper and performance art pioneer Rose English, with Cooper composing the music and English handling art direction and costumes. Scheduled for its first theatrical release in Japan in August 2026.
t54852.tmdb_overview_en: An avant-garde examination of the relationship between women and money in society. Mixing musical, silent melodrama, and philosophical treatise into a post-punk, heady brew.

t325956.synopsis: イギリスの女性監督ロビーナ・ローズが1981年に手がけた唯一の長編監督作。 ロンドンのノッティングヒルにあるポートベロー・ホテル。夜勤の受付係の女性はルーティンワークをこなしながら、風変わりな宿泊客たちを静かに見つめている。ライブを終えたバンドマンたち、落ちぶれた伯爵夫人、夜通しポーカーに興じる男たち。まるで幻燈のような光景が映し出され、ホテルは睡眠と覚醒の間で境界的な空間と化していく。 主演はイギリスのパンクカルチャーのアイコン的存在で、デレク・ジャーマン監督作「ジュビリー」に出演するなど俳優としても活動したジョーダン（パメラ・ルーク）。アメリカのインディペンデント映画作家ジョン・ジョストが撮影を手がけ、伝説的楽団「ペンギン・カフェ・オーケストラ」のサイモン・ジェフスが音楽を担当。そのほかにも1980年代初頭のロンドンのアート＆カウンターカルチャーに関わる人々が参加し、独自の世界観を作り上げた。長年にわたり鑑賞困難な状況にあったが、2024年に4K修復が行われ、日本では2026年8月に劇場初公開。
t325956.synopsis_en: The only feature film directed by British female director Robina Rose, made in 1981. At the Portobello Hotel in Notting Hill, London, a female night receptionist goes about her routine work while quietly observing the eccentric guests. Musicians after a gig, a down-and-out countess, men playing poker all night. Scenes unfold like a magic lantern show, transforming the hotel into a liminal space between sleep and wakefulness. Starring Jordan (Pamela Rooke), an iconic figure of British punk culture who also acted in Derek Jarman's 'Jubilee.' The cinematography was handled by American independent filmmaker John Jost, and the music was composed by Simon Jeffes of the legendary Penguin Cafe Orchestra. Others involved in London's early 1980s art and counterculture scene participated, creating a unique world. The film was difficult to see for many years, but a 4K restoration was completed in 2024, and it is scheduled for its first theatrical release in Japan in August 2026.
t325956.tmdb_overview_en: As night falls, the receptionist of a small hotel dutifully performs her routine tasks while strange lodgers descend upon the dark corners of the inn.

t566737.tmdb_overview_en: Nine maids serve the household of a writer and his wife. The couple treat their maids like daughters and marry them off to eligible men. So, they are forever looking for new maids. As the years go by maid servants become hired help and more bossy and independent, so Chikura and his wife find themselves adjusting their lives to keep up with changing times.

t286869.tmdb_overview_en: Having completed the first year at his new medical practice, a doctor plans to relax on his day off. However, it is not to be: on this hectic day a man just back from the war front visits the doctor with a medical emergency, followed by a woman who claims to have been molested. Then a yakuza arrives to ask the doctor to cut his finger off...

t1315477.movie_title: 済州島四・三事件 ハラン
t1315477.movie_title_jp: 済州島四・三事件 ハラン
t1315477.clean_title_jp: 済州島四・三事件 ハラン
t1315477.synopsis: 1948年、政府が3万人もの島民を虐殺し、長らく隠蔽してきた「済州島四・三事件」。暴力に追い詰められ、極限の中での母娘の命がけの逃避行を描く。
t1315477.synopsis_en: Based on the 'Jeju April 3 Incident,' a massacre in which nearly 30,000 people are said to have been killed but which was covered up for a long time, this drama depicts the flight of a mother and daughter desperately trying to survive while being driven into a corner by unreasonable violence. On April 3, 1948, the 'Jeju April 3 Incident' began when some islanders on Jeju Island, opposed to interference by foreign forces, staged an armed uprising. From October of the same year, the government designated areas more than 5 kilometers from the coastline as 'hostile zones' and issued a proclamation stating, 'Anyone entering or leaving will be shot without condition.' To escape disaster, the villagers head for Hallasan Mountain, which rises in the center of Jeju Island. A-jin, a woman who has to leave the village temporarily, is extremely worried about her 6-year-old daughter Hye-sen, whom she left behind. Meanwhile, in the village, the South Korean army is mercilessly shooting the elderly. Surviving, Hye-sen heads into the mountains alone to find her mother. After miraculously reuniting, the mother and daughter embark on a life-or-death escape to survive. Directed and written by Ha Myeong-mi, who built her career as a screenwriter for commercial films, it vividly portrays the nameless people tossed about by state power. Kim Hyang-gi, known for 'Along with the Gods' and 'Innocent Witness,' stars as A-jin.
t1315477.tmdb_overview_en: Set against the backdrop of the Jeju Uprising in 1948, which was sparked by an armed revolt of islanders fearing the division of Korea into North and South, the film portrays the tragic consequences of an indiscriminate punitive expedition by the South Korean government. Under the guise of an anti-communist campaign, more than 25,000 civilians were slaughtered. Through the story of a mother fiercely protecting her young daughter, the film highlights the resilience and strength of Jeju women amidst the chaos.
t1315477.tmdb_overview_jp: 1948年4月3日、外国勢力による干渉に反発した済州島の一部島民が武装蜂起したことに端を発した「済州島四・三事件」。同年10月より、政府は海岸線から5キロ以上離れた地域を「敵性区域」とみなし、「出入りする者は無条件に射殺する」という布告文を発令した。村人たちは難を逃れるため、済州島の中央にそびえる漢拏山（ハルラサン）を目指す。一時的に村を出ることになった女性アジンは、村に残してきた6歳の娘ヘセンのことが心配でたまらない。その頃、村では韓国軍が老人たちを容赦なく射殺していた。生き残ったヘセンは、母を捜すためたったひとりで山へ向かう。奇跡的に再会を果たした母娘は、生き延びるため命がけの逃避行に出る。

t1464883.synopsis: 独裁政権下のイラク。大統領の誕生日ケーキ係に選ばれた少女は材料集めに奔走するが…。監督の実体験から生まれた、知られざる宝物のような物語！
t1464883.synopsis_en: Lamia, chosen as the 'honorable' cake maker, goes out to town with her grandmother and friend the rooster to search for cake ingredients──
t1464883.tmdb_overview_en: While people across 1990s Iraq struggle to survive the war and food shortages, Saddam Hussein requires each school in the country to prepare a cake to celebrate his birthday. Despite her efforts to avoid getting picked, 9-year-old Lamia is chosen among her classmates. The young girl must now use her wits and imagination to gather ingredients for the mandatory cake or face the consequences.

genres: サイエンスフィクション
t1553969.synopsis: 「怪物」「万引き家族」の是枝裕和監督が、綾瀬はるかとお笑いコンビ「千鳥」の大悟を主演に迎え、亡き息子の姿をしたヒューマノイドを迎え入れた夫婦の物語をオリジナル脚本で描いた長編映画。 少し先の未来。建築家の甲本音々とその夫で工務店の2代目社長を務める健介は、2年前に亡くした息子・翔の姿をしたヒューマノイドを迎え入れることになる。ヒューマノイドが到着した日、翔と同じ笑顔と声をした彼を音々が喜んで迎える一方で、健介は戸惑いを隠しきれず硬い表情を浮かべる。家族の時間は少しずつ動き出すが、やがて予期せぬ事態が起こり、夫婦が息子の死に対してそれぞれ抱えていた想いがあらわになっていく。そんな中、ヒューマノイドの翔はひそかにヒューマノイドの仲間たちとつながりはじめる。 夫婦の亡き息子・翔とその姿をしたヒューマノイド役には、オーディションで200人以上の中から選ばれた桒木里夢を抜てき。音々の妹・小滝亜利寿役で清野菜名、健介が経営する工務店タマケンの従業員・日高玄役で寛一郎、音々の母・西村信代役で余貴美子、タマケンの熟練工・山縣昭男役で田中泯が共演。タイトルの「箱の中の羊」は、サン＝テグジュペリの名作小説「星の王子さま」の1節に由来する。2026年・第79回カンヌ国際映画祭コンペティション部門出品。
t1553969.synopsis_en: A feature film directed by Hirokazu Kore-eda ("Monster", "Shoplifters"), starring Haruka Ayase and Daigo (from the comedy duo "Chidori"), based on an original script about a couple who welcome a humanoid in the form of their deceased son. Set in the near future. Architect Kōmoto Oto and her husband Kensuke, the second-generation president of a construction company, take in a humanoid resembling their son Sho, who died two years ago. On the day the humanoid arrives, Oto joyfully welcomes him with Sho's same smile and voice, while Kensuke hides his bewilderment behind a stiff expression. Family time gradually begins, but an unexpected event occurs, revealing the couple's hidden feelings about their son's death. Meanwhile, the humanoid Sho secretly starts connecting with other humanoids. The role of the deceased son Sho and his humanoid counterpart is played by Kuwaki Rito, chosen from over 200 auditionees. Kiyono Yasho plays Oto's younger sister Kotaki Arisu; Kanichiro plays Nikawa Gen, an employee at Kensuke's construction company Tamaken; Yo Kimiko plays Oto's mother Nishimura Nobuyo; and Tanaka Min plays Yamagata Akio, a skilled worker at Tamaken. The title "The Sheep in the Box" is derived from a passage in Antoine de Saint-Exupéry's classic novel "The Little Prince". The film was selected for the Competition section of the 79th Cannes Film Festival in 2026.
t1553969.tmdb_overview_en: Set in the near future, Otone Komoto works as an architect. She is married to Kensuke Komoto, who runs a construction company. The married couple decide to welcome a humanoid robot into their home as their son.

t1225624.synopsis: 物流センターで働くポルトガル移民・オーロラの単調な日々はスマホの故障を機に変化し…。監督の経験を基に現代の孤独と分断、かすかな希望を描く。
t1225624.synopsis_en: This human drama depicts the loneliness and division in modern society through the daily life of an immigrant woman working in a massive logistics center in Scotland, ultimately finding a faint glimmer of hope. Aurora, a Portuguese immigrant, works as a picker in a huge logistics center on the outskirts of Scotland. Her days are mostly spent walking through countless aisles following scanner instructions and retrieving items from shelves. Conversations with colleagues are limited to brief breaks, and after her shift, she drags her tired body back to a shared house for immigrant workers. Interactions among residents are superficial, relationships never deepen, and her rootless days continue monotonously. One day, Aurora accidentally breaks her smartphone. Losing this modern necessity—her means of workplace communication and her "companion" for passing time—slowly but surely begins to change her daily life. Portuguese-born, Scotland-based Laura Carreira wrote and directed her first feature film based on her own experiences as an immigrant, winning the Best Director Award at the 72nd San Sebastián International Film Festival in 2024.
t1225624.tmdb_overview_en: Aurora, a Portuguese migrant, works as an order picker in a warehouse in Edinburgh, Scotland. Caught between the walls of a huge distribution centre and the solitude of her own room, Aurora tries to seize every opportunity to resist the alienation and isolation that threaten her identity.
