t37836.tmdb_overview_en: At the identification of a dead body, a couple and a morgue employee both claim to be related to the deceased, and therefore the rightful recipient of an indemnity of at least 520,000.

t1316719.synopsis: 「新感染　ファイナル・エクスプレス」のヨン・サンホ監督が2018年に発表した自身初のグラフィックノベルを映画化したサスペンスミステリー。 生まれつき目が見えないハンデを乗り越え、著名な篆刻家（てんこくか）となったイム・ヨンギュ。息子のドンファンは偉大な父を敬い、事業を陰ながら支えていた。そんなドンファンに、警察から40年前に消息不明になった母チョン・ヨンヒの遺体が地中深くから発見されたとの知らせが届く。ヨンヒは何者かに殺された可能性があるという。あるドキュメンタリー番組のプロデューサーの提案で、ドンファンは母の死の真相を探り始める。調査を進める中で、ドンファンはヨンヒが「醜い顔」をしていたという証言を次々と耳にし、ショックに打ちひしがれる。やがて、ドンファンは母の死をめぐるある事実に直面する。 「ただ悪より救いたまえ」「密輸 1970」のパク・ジョンミンが主人公ドンファン役を務めたほか、回想シーンに登場する若き日のヨンギュ役も演じた。父ヨンギュ役は「小川のほとりで」のクォン・ヘヒョ、ヨンヒ役はヨン監督のNetflix映画「啓示」のシン・ヒョンビンが担当した。
t1316719.synopsis_en: Yeong-gyu is a blind seal engraver who carves the most beautiful stamps in South Korea. To his son Dong-hwan, his father was 'a miracle itself.' But one day, the skeletal remains of his mother Yeong-hui, who disappeared 40 years ago, are discovered—and it holds the potential of being a 'murder.' To uncover the truth behind the death of the mother whose face he never knew, Dong-hwan traces the testimonies of those who knew her. Yet, all he hears are strange words: 'She had a face as ugly as a monster.' Why was his mother so disparaged? Is it the truth, or a distorted memory? What eventually emerges is not the 'face' of one woman, but the prejudice, malice, and collective madness lurking within humanity. The moment the sealed truth is revealed, a powerful shock that will go down in film history strikes the audience!
t1316719.tmdb_overview_en: One day while overseeing a documentary crew filming his blind father at work, Im Dong-hwan gets a phone call that his missing mother’s remains have been found after forty years. Determined to find the truth of her disappearance, Dong-hwan embarks on a twisted odyssey through his family’s traumatic past, uncovering dark secrets along the way.

t43001.movie_title_original: Cybèle ou les dimanches de ville d'Avray
t43001.director: セルジュ・ブールギニョン
t43001.synopsis_en: The tragic story of a young orphan girl who develops a friendship with a French Indochina War veteran—a pure but emotionally troubled man.
t43001.tmdb_overview_en: The tragic story of a young orphan girl who is befriended by an innocent but emotionally disabled veteran of the French Indochina War.
t43001.tmdb_overview_jp: フランス領インドシナ戦争の退役軍人で、純粋だが感情的に問題を抱えた男性と友情を育む、幼い孤児の少女の悲劇的な物語。

t585077.synopsis_en: Ruka, a middle school girl who struggles to put her feelings into words, has no place at home or at school during the long summer vacation, so she visits the aquarium where her father works. There she meets a mysterious boy named Umi, who was said to have been raised by a dugong, and his older brother Sora. Before long, triggered by the three meeting, various phenomena begin to occur across the Earth.
t585077.tmdb_overview_en: Ruka is a young girl whose parents are separated and whose father works in an aquarium. When two boys, Umi and Sora, who were raised in the sea by dugongs, are brought to the aquarium, Ruka feels drawn to them and begins to realize that she has the same sort of supernatural connection to the ocean that they do. Umi and Sora's special power seems to be connected to strange events that have been occurring more and more frequently, such as the appearance of sea creatures far from their home territory and the disappearance of aquarium animals around the world. However, the exact nature of the boys' power and of the abnormal events is unknown, and Ruka gets drawn into investigating the mystery that surrounds her new friends.
t585077.tmdb_overview_jp: 自分の気持ちを言葉にするのが苦手な中学生の琉花は、長い夏休みの間、家にも学校にも居場所がなく、父親の働いている水族館へと足を運ぶ。そこで彼女は、ジュゴンに育てられたという不思議な少年・海と、その兄である空と出会う。やがて3人が出会ったことをきっかけに、地球上でさまざまな現象が起こりはじめる。

t1095805.movie_title: スタントマン　武替道
t1095805.movie_title_jp: スタントマン　武替道
t1095805.clean_title_jp: スタントマン 武替道
t1095805.synopsis: 香港アクション映画界の現場に欠くことのできないスタントマンたちに焦点を当て、仕事と夢に情熱を注ぐスタントマンたちの姿を描いたドラマ。日本でも人気を集めた「トワイライト・ウォリアーズ　決戦！九龍城砦」のテレンス・ラウとフィリップ・ンが出演。 1980年代、売れっ子アクション監督として活躍していたサムは、撮影中に危険なアクションシーンを強行したことでスタントマンを半身不随にしてしまい、映画業界を引退する。時は流れ、整骨院を営み静かに暮らしていたサムのもとに、かつての仲間から「もう一度アクション映画の監督をやってほしい」という依頼が舞い込み、数十年ぶりに映画制作に参加する。しかし、アクション映画の現場は、かつてとは異なりコンプライアンスも厳しく、リアリティを追求するサムのやり方に俳優のワイや製作陣が反発し、現場はぎくしゃくする。若手スタントマンのロンは、サムを献身的にフォローし何とか撮影を進めようとするが……。 サム役を、「ツイン・ドラゴン」など数々の作品でアクション指導を務め、「燃えよドラゴン」などに出演もした香港アクション映画界のレジェンド、トン・ワイが演じた。若手スタントマンのロン役をテレンス・ラウ、人気アクション俳優のワイ役をフィリップ・ンがそれぞれ担当。監督は双子のアクション俳優として活躍し、本作が初監督となるアルバート・レオンとハーバート・レオン。タイトルの「武替道（ぶたいどう）」は中国語で「スタントの道」の意味。
t1095805.synopsis_en: In the 1980s, Sam was active as a sought-after action director, but after forcing a dangerous action scene during filming that left a stuntman paralyzed, he retired from the film industry. Years later, Sam, now quietly running an osteopathic clinic, receives a request from former colleagues to "direct an action movie once more," and he joins a film production for the first time in decades. However, the action film set is different from before, with strict compliance rules, and Sam's approach of pursuing realism clashes with the actor Wai and the production team, making the set tense. Young stuntman Ron devotedly supports Sam and tries to keep the shoot going, but...
t1095805.tmdb_overview_en: A washed-up action choreographer, struggling to find his way in a changing industry, risks everything to stage an epic comeback, and attempts to repair the relationship with his estranged daughter before it's too late.
t1095805.tmdb_overview_jp: 1980年代、売れっ子アクション監督として活躍していたサムは、撮影中に危険なアクションシーンを強行したことでスタントマンを半身不随にしてしまい、映画業界を引退する。時は流れ、整骨院を営み静かに暮らしていたサムのもとに、かつての仲間から「もう一度アクション映画の監督をやってほしい」という依頼が舞い込み、数十年ぶりに映画制作に参加する。しかし、アクション映画の現場は、かつてとは異なりコンプライアンスも厳しく、リアリティを追求するサムのやり方に俳優のワイや製作陣が反発し、現場はぎくしゃくする。若手スタントマンのロンは、サムを献身的にフォローし何とか撮影を進めようとするが……。

t674813.movie_title: 幻愛　夢の向こうに
t674813.movie_title_jp: 幻愛　夢の向こうに
t674813.synopsis: 「トワイライト・ウォリアーズ　決戦！九龍城砦」のテレンス・ラウとセシリア・チョイが共演し、現実と幻の境界をさまよう男女の切ない愛を描いたラブストーリー。 小学校教師のレイ・ジーロックは、統合失調症を患いながらも、どうにか日常生活を送っていた。彼は偶然出会った女性ヤンヤンに一目ぼれし、仲を深めていくが、自身の病について打ち明けることができない。その間に症状は悪化していき、やがてヤンヤンそのものがジーロックの幻覚だったことが判明。ジーロックは治療のためのセラピーの場で、ヤンヤンに瓜二つの女性イップ・ラムと出会う。彼女は心理学を専攻する大学院生で、統合失調症の症状のひとつである「恋愛妄想」を研究していた。理想的な研究対象であるロックに論文執筆の協力を依頼するラムだったが、いつしか2人は研究者と患者の立場を超える感情を抱くようになる。 監督は「十年」「時代革命」のキウィ・チョウ。統合失調症に苦しみながらも愛を求めようとする青年ジーロックをテレンス・ラウ、彼が恋に落ちるヤンヤンとラムをセシリア・チョイが演じ、第26回香港電影評論學會大奨で最優秀男優賞と最優秀女優賞をそれぞれ受賞した。
t674813.synopsis_en:
Terence Lau (*Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In*) and Cecilia Choi star in this poignant love story depicting a man and woman wandering the boundary between reality and illusion.

Primary school teacher Lai Chi-lok manages to lead a functional life despite suffering from schizophrenia. He falls in love at first sight with a woman named Yan Yan, but as they grow closer, he is unable to confess his illness to her. As his symptoms worsen, it is eventually revealed that Yan Yan herself was a hallucination. During a therapy session, Lok meets Ip Lam, a woman who is the spitting image of Yan Yan. A graduate student majoring in psychology, Lam is researching "erotomania," a symptom of schizophrenia. Though she initially asks Lok to cooperate with her thesis as an ideal research subject, the two soon develop feelings that transcend the roles of researcher and patient.

The film is directed by Kiwi Chow (*Ten Years*, *Revolution of Our Times*). Terence Lau plays Chi-lok, a young man seeking love while struggling with schizophrenia, and Cecilia Choi plays both Yan Yan and Lam. Their performances won Best Actor and Best Actress, respectively, at the 26th Hong Kong Film Critics Society Awards.
t674813.tmdb_overview_en: Lok is a recovering schizophrenic who yearns for love. One day, he encounters the young and beautiful Yan and quickly falls in love with her. The pair develops a relationship that is beyond their wildest dreams.

t354759.synopsis: 演技経験のない4人の女性を主演に、ごく普通の30代後半の女性たちが抱える不安や悩みを、総時間317分の緊迫感あふれるドラマとして描いた。映画学校の生徒たちを起用した4時間を超える大作「親密さ」や、東北記録映画3部作（「なみのおと」「なみのこえ」「うたうひと」）など挑戦的な作品作りを続ける濱口竜介監督が手がけ、スイスの第68回ロカルノ国際映画祭で、主演4人が最優秀女優賞を受賞した。30代も後半を迎えた、あかり、桜子、芙美、純の4人は、なんでも話せる親友同士だと思っていた。しかし、純が1年にわたる離婚協議を隠していたことが発覚。そのことで動揺した4人は、つかの間の慰めにと有馬温泉へ旅行にでかけ、楽しい時間を過ごすが……。
t354759.synopsis_en: Starring four women with no acting experience, this film portrays the anxieties and worries of ordinary women in their late 30s through a tense 317-minute drama. Directed by Ryusuke Hamaguchi, known for challenging works like the 4-hour-plus epic "Intimacies" (using film school students) and the Tohoku documentary trilogy ("The Sound of the Waves," "Voices from the Waves," "Singing in the Dark"), the film won the Best Actress award for its four leads at the 68th Locarno International Film Festival in Switzerland. Akari, Sakurako, Fumi, and Jun, all in their late 30s, thought they were best friends who could tell each other anything. However, it is revealed that Jun had been hiding her year-long divorce negotiations. Shaken by this, the four women take a trip to Arima Onsen for a brief escape and enjoy a fun time together, but...
t354759.tmdb_overview_en: Four women in their thirties reevaluate their relationships, both shared and private, after a startling revelation concerning one's marriage forces each of them to ask one of life's biggest questions: "Am I who I want to be?"
t354759.tmdb_overview_jp: ４人の女性たちが直面するそれぞれの人生の岐路  30代も後半を迎えた、あかり、桜子、芙美、純の4人は、なんでも話せる親友同士だと思っていた。純の秘密を知るまでは……。中学生の息子がいる桜子は、多忙な夫を支えながら家庭を守る平凡な暮らしにどこか寂しさを感じていた。編集者である夫をもつ芙美もまた、真に向き合うことのできないうわべだけ良好な夫婦関係に言い知れぬ不安を覚えていた。あかりはバツイチ独身の看護師。できの悪い後輩に手を焼きながら多忙な日々を過ごし、病院で知り合った男性からアプローチを受けるも今は恋愛をする気になれずにいる。  純の現状を思わぬかたちで知った彼女たちの動揺は、いつしか自身の人生をも大きく動かすきっかけとなっていく。つかの間の慰めに4人は有馬温泉へ旅行に出かけ楽しい時を過ごすが、純の秘めた決意を3人は知る由もなかった。やがてくる長い夜に彼女たちは問いかける。  —私は本当になりたかった私なの？

t1802.director: クロード・シャブロル
t1802.synopsis: フランス映画界の名匠クロード・シャブロルが、英国の作家ルース・レンデルの小説「ロウフィールド館の惨劇」を原作に、ある殺意が生まれるまでを冷徹に描いたサスペンス。イザベル・ユペールとサンドリーヌ・ボネールという現代フランスを代表する2人の女優が共演し、1995年の第52回ベネチア国際映画祭で、そろって女優賞に輝いた。 裕福な一家に家政婦として雇われたソフィーは、真面目に働く一方で、誰にも知られたくない秘密を抱えていた。ある日、彼女は郵便局で働く奔放な女性ジャンヌと知り合い、2人は急速に親密になっていく。立場も性格も異なる女たちが孤独を分かち合うなか、やがて一家にソフィーの秘密が発覚し、穏やかだった日常は思いもよらぬ方向へと転がっていく。 主演の2人のほか、一家の主婦役にジャクリーヌ・ビセット、夫役にジャン＝ピエール・カッセルが顔をそろえる。脚本はシャブロルとカロリーヌ・エリアシェフ。日本で1996年に「沈黙の女　ロウフィールド館の惨劇」の邦題で劇場公開。2026年、邦題を「沈黙の女」に改め、特集上映「クロード・シャブロル傑作選 vol.2」にてデジタルリマスター版で再公開される。
t1802.synopsis_en: Sophie is hired as a housekeeper for a wealthy family. She works diligently, but she harbors a secret she must never reveal. One day, Sophie meets Jeanne, a free-spirited postal worker, and the two strike up a friendship. Before long, Sophie's secret is exposed to the family... A masterpiece that coldly captures the irony of human kindness that pricks at insecurities, the hostility that once set in motion cannot be stopped, and the helpless plight of two women bound together by wrongdoing. Stars Bonnaire and Huppert both won the Best Actress award at the 52nd Venice International Film Festival. (1995) *Screened in digitally remastered format [Screening dates] Aug 28 (Fri), Aug 29 (Sat), Aug 31 (Mon), Sep 1 (Tue), Sep 3 (Thu), Sep 4 (Fri), Sep 6 (Sun), Sep 7 (Mon), Sep 9 (Wed), Sep 10 (Thu), Sep 12 (Sat), Sep 13 (Sun), Sep 15 (Tue), Sep 16 (Wed)
t1802.tmdb_overview_en: Sophie, a quiet and shy maid working for an upper-class French family, finds a friend in the energetic and uncompromising postmaster Jeanne, who encourages her to stand up against her bourgeois employers.

t5165.director: ミケランジェロ・アントニオーニ
t5165.synopsis: イタリアの巨匠ミケランジェロ・アントニオーニを代表する一作で、アントニオーニの代名詞ともいえる男女の「愛の不毛」を描き、論争を巻き起こしながらも第13回カンヌ国際映画祭で審査員賞を受賞した。 ローマの外交官の娘アンナは、恋人のサンドロや親友のクラウディアら友人たちとヨットで地中海の船旅に出るが、立ち寄った無人島で、アンナはふいに姿を消してしまう。残された恋人のサンドロと親友クラウディアは懸命にアンナの行方を捜すが手がかりはつかめず、ほかの友人たちは何事もなかったかのように日常へ戻っていく。捜索を続ける中でサンドロとクラウディアは、次第に距離を縮めていくが……。 クラウディア役を、「夜」「太陽はひとりぼっち」などアントニオーニのミューズとして知られるモニカ・ビッティが演じ、サンドロ役を「三月生れ」「女王陛下の007」のガブリエレ・フェルゼッティ、アンナ役を「狂った情事」のレア・マッサリが演じた。日本では1962年に劇場初公開。2026年8月、アントニオーニ初期5作を集めた特集上映「ミケランジェロ・アントニオーニ　レトロスペクティヴ　愛の不毛、彷徨える魂」にて、4K修復版で公開。
t5165.synopsis_en: Sandro, his lover Anna, and her friend Claudia go sailing on a yacht. When they land on a certain island, Anna suddenly disappears. Sandro and Claudia search for her, but gradually find themselves drawn to each other, giving in to their desires despite their guilt.
t5165.tmdb_overview_en: Claudia and Anna join Anna's lover, Sandro, on a boat trip to a remote volcanic island. When Anna goes missing, a search is launched. In the meantime, Sandro and Claudia become involved in a romance despite Anna's disappearance, though the relationship suffers from guilt and tension.
t5165.tmdb_overview_jp: ヨットで遠乗りに出かけたサンドロ、恋人のアンナ、その友人・クラウディア。とある島に上陸すると、突然アンナが姿を消してしまう。サンドロとクラウディアは彼女を捜し回るが、2人は次第に惹かれあい、やましさを覚えながらも求めてしまう。

n女ともだち1955.director: ミケランジェロ・アントニオーニ
n女ともだち1955.synopsis: 「情事」「夜」「太陽はひとりぼっち」の「愛の不毛」3部作などで知られるイタリアの巨匠ミケランジェロ・アントニオーニが1955年に手がけた長編第3作。トリノを舞台に、偶然出会った女性5人の不安定な関係性を独自の映像表現で描き、第16回ベネチア国際映画祭銀獅子賞を受賞した。 ローマを本拠とする高級洋装店に勤めるクレリアは、トリノにオープンする支店の支配人として同地にやってくる。ある夜、宿泊先のホテルの隣室で、自殺未遂を図って気を失っている女性ロゼッタを発見する。このことをきっかけにクレリアは、ロゼッタや彼女の友人モミナたちと友情を深めていくが……。 原作はチェーザレ・パベーゼの小説「孤独な女たちの中に」。出演は「埋れた青春」のエレオノラ・ロッシ＝ドラゴ、「情事」のガブリエレ・フェルゼッティ、「映画に愛をこめて　アメリカの夜」のバレンティナ・コルテーゼほか。日本では1964年に劇場初公開。2026年8月、アントニオーニ初期5作を集めた特集上映「ミケランジェロ・アントニオーニ　レトロスペクティヴ　愛の不毛、彷徨える魂」にて、2K修復版で公開。
n女ともだち1955.synopsis_en: The third feature film by Italian master Michelangelo Antonioni, known for the 'trilogy of arid love' including L'Avventura, La Notte, and L'Eclisse, made in 1955. Set in Turin, it depicts the unstable relationships of five women who meet by chance through his distinctive visual style, winning the Silver Lion at the 16th Venice International Film Festival. Clelia, who works at a high-end dress shop based in Rome, arrives in Turin as the manager of a new branch opening there. One night, in the hotel room next to her lodging, she discovers Rosetta unconscious after a suicide attempt. Through this incident, Clelia deepens her friendship with Rosetta and her friend Momina... Based on Cesare Pavese's novel "Among Women Only." Starring Eleonora Rossi Drago from "The Golden Coach," Gabriele Ferzetti from L'Avventura, and Valentina Cortese from "Day for Night," among others. First released in Japanese theaters in 1964. A 2K restored version will be shown in August 2026 at the retrospective "Michelangelo Antonioni Retrospective: Arid Love, Wandering Souls," featuring five of Antonioni's early works.

t713494.tmdb_overview_en: A man who survived the war carries the will of his comrades in arms, walking across the country visiting the bereaved families.

t1567504.synopsis: 愛知県犬山市でオールロケを敢行し、幽霊が見える女性と見えない恋人が繰り広げる戦いを描いた奇想天外なアクションラブコメディ。 幽霊を見ることができる水野美里と見ることができない奥村拓人のカップルは、齢1200年の大妖怪である妖狐玉藻の霊に立ち向かうことになる。玉藻は自分を殺した人間への復讐を果たすため、美里の霊力を奪って幽霊軍団を結成する。玉藻を倒すべく、公務員陰陽師チームや一癖も二癖もあるフリーの霊能力者たちが入り乱れ、除霊合戦が繰り広げられるが……。 愛知発のアイドルグループ「TEAM SHACHI」の元メンバーである大黒柚姫が美里役、名古屋を拠点にアーティスト・実業家として活動する平野莉玖が拓人役で主演を務め、妖狐玉藻役の勇翔、霊能者役の須田亜香里ら、共演にも愛知に縁のある俳優やタレントを中心に起用。犬山市在住のテレビ番組ディレクター・フルヤカツトシが長編初監督を務め、自主制作映画として完成させた。ピアノロックバンド「Qaijff（クアイフ）」が主題歌を担当。
t1567504.synopsis_en: An outrageous action romantic comedy shot entirely on location in Inuyama City, Aichi Prefecture, depicting the battle between a woman who can see ghosts and her boyfriend who cannot. Misato Mizuno, who can see ghosts, and Takuya Okumura, who cannot, find themselves facing the spirit of Tamamo, a 1,200-year-old great yokai fox. To exact revenge on the humans who killed her, Tamamo steals Misato's spiritual powers and forms a ghost army. To defeat Tamamo, a team of civil servant onmyoji and a group of eccentric freelance psychics all clash in an escalating exorcism battle... Yuzuki Daikoku, former member of Aichi-based idol group TEAM SHACHI, plays Misato, while Riku Hirano, an artist and entrepreneur based in Nagoya, stars as Takuya. The supporting cast is centered on actors and talents with ties to Aichi, including Yusho as the fox spirit Tamamo and Akari Suda as a psychic. Katsutoshi Furuya, a TV director living in Inuyama City, makes his feature directorial debut, completing the film as an independent production. Piano rock band Qaijff handles the theme song.
t1567504.tmdb_overview_en: Misato loves food from all over the world and sees ghosts everywhere. She gently pets a fox spirit and believes that each person has their own unique ghost. As in a clichéd film, Misato falls for the handsome Takuto, who can read minds.

t41245.movie_title: ペパーミント・キャンディー 4Kレストア
t41245.movie_title_jp: ペパーミント・キャンディー
t41245.clean_title_jp: ペパーミント・キャンディー
t41245.synopsis_en: A human drama that traces twenty years in the life of a man against the backdrop of modern Korean history, winning five major awards including Best Picture at the Grand Bell Awards, South Korea's equivalent of the Oscars. This is the second feature film by director Lee Chang-dong, made in 1999, known for "Oasis" and "Secret Sunshine." Spring, 1999. Kim Yeong-ho, at the depths of despair after losing his job and family, shows up at a picnic with old friends wearing an out-of-place suit. It is the same place he visited twenty years earlier with his first love, Sunim. Standing on the railroad tracks, Yeong-ho shouts "I want to go back!" at an oncoming train, and his life begins to rewind. We see his self-destructed marriage to his wife Hong-ja, his love for Sunim that drew them together but was never fulfilled, and the Gwangju Uprising he witnessed as a soldier. Yeong-ho's journey through memory eventually arrives at the time twenty years ago when his life was most beautiful and pure. The film was released in a 4K-restored digital remaster in 2019 to coincide with the release of Lee Chang-dong's "Burning." A 4K restoration was also screened in 2023 as part of the special retrospective "Lee Chang-dong Retrospective 4K."
t41245.tmdb_overview_en: In the spring of 1999, a group of old friends gather to celebrate their 20 year reunion. Among the group is Yeong-ho, a cold, unhappy man, whose demeanor puts a damper on the festivities. The seriousness of Yeong-ho's depression becomes apparent when he climbs a railroad bridge and looks like he might jump. At this crucial moment, memories of seven crucial episodes from Yeong-ho's past flood his mind.
t41245.tmdb_overview_jp: 1999年春。鉄道の高架下で男ヨンホは全てを失ったいま、過去を振り返っていた。3日前、ヨンホは危篤状態にある初恋の相手、スニムを見舞う。数年前には行きずりのバーのホステスにスニムの面影を見る。さらに3年前、新米刑事のヨンホのもとにスニムがやって来るが、彼はそっけなく追い返してしまう。その4年前には兵役についたヨンホを訪ねたスニムだが面会許可がおりなかった。そしてその1年前、青年ヨンホはスニムとこの高架下で互いの将来を語り合っていた。

t26955.synopsis_en: After serving two years and six months for a hit-and-run incident—following an assault and attempted rape—John-Do is released from prison. When he returns to his family, no one welcomes him warmly, and they don't hide their resentment. One day, he visits the family of the victim he killed in the hit-and-run. However, the family is in the middle of moving, and only a woman named Gong-ju is left behind in the room. She suffers from severe cerebral palsy, leaving her unable to move her limbs freely and with serious speech impairments. Her older brother and his wife had obtained a large apartment for the disabled in her name and moved there, abandoning her. John-Do begins to grow concerned about Gong-ju...
t26955.tmdb_overview_en: A young man released from prison visits the widow of the man he killed drunk-driving and becomes infatuated with his cerebral palsy-stricken daughter.
t26955.tmdb_overview_jp: 暴行、強姦未遂に続いて、今度はひき逃げ事件による2年6ヵ月の刑を終えたばかりのジョンドゥ。出所して家族のもとに戻った彼を、誰も快く迎えようとはせず疎ましい感情を隠そうともしない。ある日、彼はひき逃げで死なせてしまった被害者遺族を訪れる。しかし、一家は引越しの最中で、部屋にはコンジュという女性一人が取り残される。彼女は重度の脳性麻痺のため手足が不自由で発語にも重い障害を抱えていた。兄夫婦は彼女の名義で障害者用の大きなアパートを手に入れ、そこへ移って行ってしまったのだ。ジョンドゥはそんなコンジュのことが気になり始める...。

t758866.movie_title: ドライブ・マイ・カー
t758866.movie_title_jp: ドライブ・マイ・カー
t758866.clean_title_jp: ドライブ・マイ・カー
t758866.movie_title_original: ドライブ・マイ・カー
t758866.synopsis: 村上春樹の短編小説集「女のいない男たち」に収録された短編「ドライブ・マイ・カー」を、「偶然と想像」でベルリン国際映画祭銀熊賞を受賞した濱口竜介監督・脚本により映画化。舞台俳優で演出家の家福悠介は、脚本家の妻・音と幸せに暮らしていた。しかし、妻はある秘密を残したまま他界してしまう。2年後、喪失感を抱えながら生きていた彼は、演劇祭で演出を担当することになり、愛車のサーブで広島へ向かう。そこで出会った寡黙な専属ドライバーのみさきと過ごす中で、家福はそれまで目を背けていたあることに気づかされていく。主人公・家福を西島秀俊、ヒロインのみさきを三浦透子、物語の鍵を握る俳優・高槻を岡田将生、家福の亡き妻・音を霧島れいかがそれぞれ演じる。2021年・第74回カンヌ国際映画祭コンペティション部門に出品され、日本映画では初となる脚本賞を受賞したほか、国際映画批評家連盟賞、AFCAE賞、エキュメニカル審査員賞の3つの独立賞も受賞。また、2022年・第94回アカデミー賞では日本映画史上初となる作品賞にノミネートされる快挙を成し遂げたほか、監督賞、脚色賞、国際長編映画賞とあわせて4部門でノミネート。日本映画としては「おくりびと」以来13年ぶりに国際長編映画賞（旧外国語映画賞）を受賞した。そのほか、第79回ゴールデングローブ賞の最優秀非英語映画賞受賞や、アジア人男性初の全米批評家協会賞主演男優賞受賞など全米の各映画賞でも大きく注目を集めた。日本アカデミー賞でも最優秀作品賞はじめ、計8冠に輝いた。
t758866.synopsis_en: Inheriting the original story of a man's loss and hope after losing his wife, this is a remarkable narrative where the story and the play within the film resonate contrapuntally, boldly incorporating theatrical elements from timeless works like 'Uncle Vanya' and 'Waiting for Godot.' It won four awards including Best Screenplay at the 74th Cannes Film Festival and won the Academy Award for Best International Feature Film at the 94th Academy Awards.
t758866.tmdb_overview_en: Yusuke Kafuku, a stage actor and director, still unable, after two years, to cope with the loss of his beloved wife, accepts to direct Uncle Vanya at a theater festival in Hiroshima. There he meets Misaki, an introverted young woman, appointed to drive his car. In between rides, secrets from the past and heartfelt confessions will be unveiled.
t758866.tmdb_overview_jp: 舞台俳優であり、演出家の家福悠介。彼は、脚本家の妻・音と満ち足りた日々を送っていた。しかし、妻はある秘密を残したまま突然この世からいなくなってしまう――。２年後、演劇祭で演出を任されることになった家福は、愛車のサーブで広島へと向かう。そこで出会ったのは、寡黙な専属ドライバーみさきだった。喪失感を抱えたまま生きる家福は、みさきと過ごすなか、それまで目を背けていたあることに気づかされていく…

t348869.tmdb_overview_en: A young couple's announcement of their engagement to their friends is followed by a series of interactions and conflicts that forces everyone to reflect on their lives.

t1156125.synopsis: 「ドライブ・マイ・カー」でアカデミー国際長編映画賞、カンヌ国際映画祭脚本賞、「偶然と想像」でベルリン国際映画祭銀熊賞（審査員グランプリ）を受賞するなど国際的に高く評価される濱口竜介監督が、カンヌ、ベルリンと並ぶ世界3大映画祭のひとつであるベネチア国際映画祭で銀獅子賞（審査員大賞）受賞を果たした長編作品。「ドライブ・マイ・カー」でもタッグを組んだ音楽家・シンガーソングライターの石橋英子と濱口監督による共同企画として誕生した。 自然豊かな高原に位置する長野県水挽町は、東京からも近いため近年移住者が増加傾向にあり、ごく緩やかに発展している。代々その地に暮らす巧は、娘の花とともに自然のサイクルに合わせた慎ましい生活を送っているが、ある時、家の近くでグランピング場の設営計画が持ち上がる。それは、コロナ禍のあおりで経営難に陥った芸能事務所が、政府からの補助金を得て計画したものだった。しかし、彼らが町の水源に汚水を流そうとしていることがわかったことから町内に動揺が広がり、巧たちの静かな生活にも思わぬ余波が及ぶことになる。 石橋がライブパフォーマンスのための映像を濱口監督に依頼したことから、プロジェクトがスタート。その音楽ライブ用の映像を制作する過程で、1本の長編映画としての本作も誕生した。2023年・第80回ベネチア国際映画祭では銀獅子賞（審査員大賞）を受賞したほか、映画祭本体とは別機関から授与される国際批評家連盟賞、映画企業特別賞、人・職場・環境賞の3つの独立賞も受賞した。
t1156125.synopsis_en: In Mizuhiki Town, Nagano Prefecture, blessed with abundant nature. Takumi and his only daughter Hana have lived modestly there for generations, but one day a plan emerges to build a glamping site nearby, and its repercussions gradually reach their lives. A feature film born alongside "GIFT," a silent live concert film by Eiko Ishibashi, who composed the music for "Drive My Car." Winner of the Silver Lion (Grand Jury Prize) at the 80th Venice International Film Festival.
t1156125.tmdb_overview_en: Takumi and his daughter Hana live in Mizubiki Village, close to Tokyo. One day, the village inhabitants become aware of a plan to build a camping site near Takumi's house offering city residents a comfortable "escape" to nature.
t1156125.tmdb_overview_jp: 巧と娘の花は、自然豊かな高原で代々慎ましく暮らしていた。彼らの住む長野県水挽町は東京から近く、移住者の増加で開発が進んでいる。ある日、コロナ禍のあおりを受けた芸能事務所が政府の補助金を得て、グランピング場の開発を進めるのだが、計画は杜撰で…

t348881.synopsis: 映画や演劇、俳優養成の専門学校「ENBUゼミナール」の演技コース修了作品としてスタートした企画から生まれた、およそ4時間におよぶ長編作品。「親密さ」という演劇を作り上げていく過程を描いた劇映画の前半部分と、実際の舞台の上演を記録した後半部分の2部構成で、それぞれの中に虚構と現実が交錯する。新作舞台の上演を間近に控えた演出家の令子と良平は、コンビで演出を手がけているが、そのやり方に次第に限界が見え始めて……。
t348881.synopsis_en: Spanning approximately four hours, this feature-length work originated as a project for the acting course graduation at ENBU Seminar, a vocational school for film, theater, and actor training. It is composed of two parts: a narrative film depicting the process of creating a play titled "Intimacies," and a recording of the actual stage performance, with fiction and reality intertwining in each. With the premiere of their new production drawing near, directors Reiko and Ryohei find the limits of their collaborative partnership beginning to show...
t348881.tmdb_overview_en: Hamaguchi wrote and directed this film as a graduation project for the students at ENBU Seminar (film and theater school in Tokyo) when he taught there. It is a three-part film: The first part is a documentary-style production of a play; Then the actual full stage production of the play; and the epilogue. Poetry and written words play the central role in the movie.

t795811.synopsis_en: Trivial love talk between best friends, a student seeking guidance from a professor, female friends reuniting after 20 years... A first 'short story collection' woven from three tales themed around 'coincidence.' With a small production system ensuring ample rehearsal and shooting time, it carefully captures the actors' light yet delicate expressions. Won the Silver Bear Grand Jury Prize at the 71st Berlin International Film Festival.
t795811.tmdb_overview_en: An unexpected love triangle, a seduction trap, and a random encounter are the three episodes, told in three movements to depict three female characters and trace the trajectories between their choices and regrets.
t795811.tmdb_overview_jp: ヘアメイクアーティストである親友のつぐみ(玄理)から好きな男がいると聞かされた、モデルの芽衣子(古川琴音)。だが、その男が元恋人の和明(中島歩)だと知る(第1話『魔法(よりもっと不確か)』)。芥川賞を受賞した大学教授・瀬川(渋川清彦)に落第させられた大学生・佐々木(甲斐翔真)は、復讐(ふくしゅう)を企てる(第2話『扉は開けたままで』)。高校時代の友人である夏子(占部房子)とあや(河井青葉)が、20年ぶりに仙台で再会。当時のことで盛り上がるが、徐々にすれ違っていく(第3話『もう一度』)。

t95482.movie_title: グリーンフィッシュ 4Kレストア
t95482.tmdb_overview_en: Returning home and finding his town drastically changed, a former soldier falls in with gangsters.

t212300.program_title: 神保町シアターセレクション 女優魂2026 ——忘れられない「この1本」
t212300.synopsis: かいせつ 戦後の混乱を背景に汚職や詐欺などの社会問題を痛烈に描いたブラック風刺劇。清純派の久我が自室で原爆作りに没頭する女を怪演し異彩を放った。
t212300.synopsis_en: A biting black satire that harshly depicts social issues such as corruption and fraud against the backdrop of postwar chaos. Kuga, known for her pure image, delivers a striking and eerie performance as a woman obsessed with building an atomic bomb in her room.
t212300.tmdb_overview_en: An ethical, young tax collector new to his area encounters increasingly absurd individuals and groups coping with their post-war woes.

t489552.program_title: 神保町シアターセレクション 女優魂2026 ——忘れられない「この1本」
t489552.synopsis: かいせつ ある芸者の男性遍歴を辿る女性映画の秀作。愛らしく、時に憎らしい、無邪気で本能のままに生きる女性を演じた若尾に、誰しも虜になること請け合い。
t489552.synopsis_en: A superb women's film tracing the romantic history of a geisha. Wakao plays a lovable, sometimes hateful, innocent woman who lives by instinct—sure to captivate every viewer.
t489552.tmdb_overview_en: A young girl is rigorously trained in the feminine arts so that she can become a geisha. As she struggles through life, she learns to live not just as a woman but as a complete person.

t170690.program_title: 神保町シアターセレクション 女優魂2026 ——忘れられない「この1本」
t170690.synopsis: かいせつ 五輪開催に沸く東京。米国行きを夢見るバンドマンは、仲間の挑発で強盗に加わるが―。風俗嬢役に挑んだ桑野のむき出しの魅力に釘付け必至。
t170690.synopsis_en: Tokyo buzzes with the Olympics. A bandman dreaming of going to America joins a robbery after being provoked by his friends. Kuwano's raw appeal in her role as a sex worker is absolutely captivating.
t170690.tmdb_overview_en: As Japan is preparing to host the Olympics, a gang member wanting to go to America is sought after by the police after helping his friend conduct a robbery.
t170690.tmdb_overview_jp: 歌手志望のチンピラ青年。彼の夢はアメリカへ歌の修業に行くこと。ある日、彼は麻薬中毒の兄貴分らと共にヤクザの金を強奪するが、潜伏先の地下室で仲間割れが始まり・・・。

t532002.program_title: 神保町シアターセレクション 女優魂2026 ——忘れられない「この1本」
t532002.synopsis: かいせつ 病身の夫を支える割烹旅館の住み込み女中が、客の男に見出され、政財界のフィクサーの情婦になるが―。池内の大胆な名演に脱帽。
t532002.synopsis_en: A live-in maid at a traditional inn supports her ailing husband, but is discovered by a male guest and becomes the mistress of a political fixer. Hats off to Ikenami's bold and remarkable performance.
t532002.tmdb_overview_en: Desperate to escape her grueling life caring for her paralyzed husband, Tamiko murders him and burns down their home to start anew. She is soon entangled in the dark web of an influential, elderly power broker, becoming his mistress and a pawn in his political schemes. As she descends further into a downward spiral of moral decay, Tamiko realizes that the freedom she sought is merely a new form of entrapment.

t1295400.synopsis_en: Danish director Anders Thomas Jensen, known for writing "Riders of Justice," "The Good Life," and "After the Wedding," delivers a human drama starring his frequent collaborator Mads Mikkelsen. After serving time for a robbery, Anker is released and reunites with his brother Manfred, who hid a large sum of money during the heist, for the first time in 15 years. However, Manfred not only has forgotten the hiding place but also believes he is John Lennon. The two set out on a journey to find the bag of hidden money, but the trip gradually transforms into a journey of self-reflection for both of them. Mikkelsen plays Manfred, who has lost his memory and believes he is John Lennon, embodying this eccentric and unique character. Anker is played by Nikolaj Lie Kaas, another frequent collaborator of Jensen's. The film had its world premiere in the Out of Competition section of the 2025 Venice International Film Festival and became a massive hit in its native Denmark, breaking the country's all-time box office record for a live-action film.
t1295400.tmdb_overview_en: After serving fourteen years for robbery, Anker is released from prison and reunites with his mentally ill brother Manfred, who alone knows where the stolen money is hidden but has forgotten its location, sending them on a journey to recover the loot and confront who they are.

nマルキ.synopsis: 登場人物がすべて動物の特殊メイク造形という設定で、マルキ・ド・サド侯爵の真の姿を描く異色ファンタジー。1789年。ちょっとした罪で投獄されたサド。そんな彼の唯一の話し相手は、なんとコランという名の自分の性器だった……。捕らえられた革命の指導者と、彼を助けようとする人々のドラマを、奇想天外なアイデアで描く。日本では東京国際ファンタスティック映画祭で上映されている。
nマルキ.synopsis_en: A unique fantasy in which all characters are portrayed through special makeup effects as animals, depicting the true face of the Marquis de Sade. In 1789, Sade is imprisoned for a minor offense. His only conversation partner is none other than his own genitalia, named Colin... The drama of a captured revolutionary leader and the people trying to save him is told with wildly imaginative ideas. It was screened in Japan at the Tokyo International Fantastic Film Festival.

t993.director: ジョセフ・Ｌ・マンキウィッツ
t993.synopsis_en: Wyke, a famous mystery novelist, summons Tindle, a hairdresser and his wife's lover, to his home. Tindle expects to be confronted about the affair, but Wyke instead declares that he is "utterly exhausted by his spendthrift wife" and that "I too have a lovely mistress," and asks Tindle to disguise himself as a thief and steal the jewels kept in his home safe. Since the jewels are covered by theft insurance, he claims it would be mutually beneficial. Although it seemed too good to be true, Tindle, who is in financial difficulty, begins stealing the jewels following Wyke's script and his bizarre procedures.
t993.tmdb_overview_en: A man who loves games and theatre invites his wife's lover to meet, setting up a battle of wits with potentially deadly results.
t993.tmdb_overview_jp: 著名なミステリー作家のワイクは、妻の不倫相手で美容師のティンドルを自宅に呼びつけた。不倫の追及を受けるものと思っていたティンドルだったが、ワイクは「浪費家の妻にはほとほと困り果てていた」「私にも素敵な愛人がいる」と切り出し、自宅の金庫に保管している宝石を泥棒に扮して盗んで欲しいと言い出した。宝石には盗難保険がかかっているため、双方に利益があるという言い分であった。あまりにも虫の良い話だったが、金銭的に厳しいティンドルはワイクの筋書きどおりに、珍妙な手順で宝石を盗み始める。

n愛と死をみつめて後篇デジタル修復版tbsレトロスペクティブ映画祭石井ふく子特集.synopsis: 手術を経て一命を取り留めたみち子(大空眞弓)。しかし、さらなる苦難が若い二人を待ち受けていた...。ほぼ病室だけで展開される密室劇だが、セリフは力強く、カメラワークも流麗で圧巻。手紙を読み上げるラストシーン、本来は台本に沿って暗転するところを、監督は現場の直感で大空眞弓の表情を撮り続けた。親の愛、恋人の愛、本人の望み...全てが切ない普遍的な愛の物語。 . .
n愛と死をみつめて後篇デジタル修復版tbsレトロスペクティブ映画祭石井ふく子特集.synopsis_en: Having survived the surgery, Michiko (Mayumi Ozora) clings to life. But even greater hardships await the young couple... Though the story unfolds almost entirely within a hospital room as a chamber drama, the dialogue is powerful and the camerawork fluid and breathtaking. In the final scene, where a letter is read aloud, the director — instead of following the script and fading to black — trusted his instincts on set and kept filming Mayumi Ozora's expression. A parent's love, a lover's love, one's own wishes... a universally poignant tale of love in which all of it comes together.

n続女と味噌汁デジタル修復版tbsレトロスペクティブ映画祭石井ふく子特集.synopsis: キッチンカーを出店するために教習所へ通うてまり(池内淳子)は、妻と別居中の弁護士・久保田(川崎敬三)と親しくなる。久保田の家を訪ねたてまりは、漬物が生き甲斐の久保田の母に気に入られてしまい、それを知った久保田の妻・やすこが乗り込んでくる...。 . .
n続女と味噌汁デジタル修復版tbsレトロスペクティブ映画祭石井ふく子特集.synopsis_en: Temari (Junko Ikeuchi), attending driving school in order to launch a food truck, grows close to Kubota (Keizo Kawasaki), a lawyer separated from his wife. When Temari visits Kubota's home, she wins over his mother, whose whole reason for living is making pickles — and when Kubota's wife Yasuko learns of this, she storms in...

t42112.director: ロベール・ブレッソン
t42112.synopsis_en: The 13th feature film by French master director Robert Bresson, who left behind masterpieces such as "Resistance: From the Prisoner's Diary" and "Mouchette." Bresson, already over 80 at the time of filming, passed away in 1999, making this his final work. Based on the novella "The Forged Coupon" by Russian literary giant Leo Tolstoy, it depicts the life of Yvon, a young fuel delivery man who, after unknowingly using a counterfeit bill that falls into his hands, triggers a family massacre and spirals downward. The title "L'argent" means "money" in French. First released in Japan in 1986. Revived in 2011 as part of "Cinema Masterpiece Selection III: The Art of Robert Bresson" with new prints. In 2026, it will be revived again in a 2K restored version as part of "Robert Bresson Masterpiece Selection."
t42112.tmdb_overview_en: A forged 500-franc note is passed from person to person and shop to shop, until it falls into the hands of a genuine innocent who doesn't see it for what it is—which will have devastating consequences on his life.
t42112.tmdb_overview_jp: 「抵抗（レジスタンス）　死刑囚の手記より」「少女ムシェット」などの名作を残したフランスの名匠ロベール・ブレッソン監督が、ロシアの文豪トルストイの原作をもとに、偶然手にしてしまったニセ札を知らずに使ってしまったことから、一家惨殺事件を引き起こし転落していく人生を歩む青年イボンの姿を描いた。

t1633056.movie_title: 八仙！【中国語音声／簡体字・英語字幕】
t1633056.synopsis: 呂洞賓、鍾離権をはじめ、韓湘子、張果老、曹国舅、鉄拐李、藍采和、何仙姑の8人が蓬莱仙境に大集結。 身分も境遇もバラバラな彼らの最優先ミッションは、ある事情により「蓬莱の人々から求められれば何でも応える」こと。 しかしその裏では、とてつもない企みが迫りつつあった・・・。
t1633056.synopsis_en: A fantasy adventure inspired by the classic Chinese myth "The Eight Immortals Cross the Sea"! Lü Dongbin, Zhongli Quan, and the other six—Han Xiangzi, Zhang Guolao, Cao Guojiu, Tie Guaili, Lan Caihe, and He Xiangu—gather at the ethereal realm of Penglai. Their top priority mission, despite their wildly different backgrounds and circumstances, is to "grant whatever the people of Penglai ask for." But behind the scenes, an unimaginable scheme is closing in...
t1633056.tmdb_overview_en: Eight grassroot mortals use their street smarts and hilarious schemes to defy powerful gods, earning their title as the Eight Immortals.

t999075.synopsis: 「フロリダ・プロジェクト　真夏の魔法」などショーン・ベイカー監督作のプロデュースやベイカー監督との共同監督作「テイクアウト」で知られるツォウ・シーチンの単独監督デビュー作。ツォウ監督の故郷・台湾を舞台に、厳しい現実と向き合う母娘とその祖父の多世代家族が織りなす物語を、幼い少女の視点からエネルギッシュかつ繊細に描き出す。 台北、夜市の麺屋台。5歳の少女イージンは、借金を背負ったシングルマザーのシューフェンとハイティーンの姉イーアンと共に、生活を立て直すため田舎町から戻ってくる。イージンは昔気質の祖父に、利き手である左手を「悪魔の手」と咎められ、罪悪感を抱くようになる。その悪魔の手は図らずも、家族それぞれが胸に秘めてきた罪をあぶり出していく。 台北に実在する「通化街夜市（臨江街夜市）」でロケを敢行。iPhoneを駆使して街の奥へと自在に入り込み、そこに生きる人々の日常を映し出す。ツォウ・シーチンとショーン・ベイカーが共同で脚本を手がけ、ベイカーが編集・製作も担当。台湾の人気子役ニーナ・イエがイージン、本作で初の本格的な演技に挑むマー・シーユエンが姉イーアン、ドラマ「暴走外科医がやってきた」のジャネル・ツァイが母シューフェンを演じた。2025年・第26回東京フィルメックスのコンペティション部門で観客賞を受賞。
t999075.synopsis_en: Taipei, a night market noodle stall. Five-year-old Yi-jin (Nina Yeh), along with her single mother Shue-fen (Janel Tsai) who is burdened with debt, and her teenage sister Yi-an (Ma Shih-yuan), returns from the countryside to rebuild their lives. One day, her old-fashioned grandfather denounces her dominant left hand as the "devil's hand," and Yi-jin begins to feel guilt. That devil's hand, inadvertently, brings to light the "sins" that each family member has been hiding.
t999075.tmdb_overview_en: A mother and her two daughters move to Taipei to open a noodle stand at a vibrant night market, but family secrets and tradition test their fresh start.
t999075.tmdb_overview_jp: シングルマザーとその2人の娘が、生活再建のために台北の夜市で麺屋台を始める。反抗的でありながらも将来への不安や焦燥を抱える長女と、祖父に「悪魔の手」と言われたために利き手である左手に罪悪感を覚える幼い次女。彼女たちがそれぞれの困難や誘惑に直面しながら、家族の絆を保とうともがく姿を描いた活気ある人間ドラマ。

t1325734.director: クリストファー・ボルグリ
t1325734.synopsis: 「スパイダーマン」シリーズのゼンデイヤと「THE BATMAN ザ・バットマン」のロバート・パティンソンがそれぞれ主演を務め、結婚式直前に暴露された“最悪の秘密”をきっかけに、完璧なカップルの関係が崩壊していく姿を描いた恋愛ドラマ。 ボストンのカフェで運命的な出会いをしたチャーリーとエマは、結婚も決まり幸せの絶頂にいた。結婚式まであと7日に迫った夜、付添人の親友夫妻と4人で食事していた彼らは、これまでに自分が犯した最悪の行いを告白することになる。軽い気持ちで始めたゲームだったが、エマの“最悪の秘密”に全員が衝撃を受け、チャーリーは彼女に別の顔があるのではないかと恐れを抱く。幸せな日々は一転して疑心暗鬼のどん底に陥るが、今さら結婚式の準備を止める訳にもいかず、ついに当日を迎えてしまう。 共演は3人姉妹バンド「HAIM」のメンバーで「ワン・バトル・アフター・アナザー」など俳優としても活躍するアラナ・ハイム、「憐れみの3章」のママドゥ・アティエ、「マーティ・シュプリーム　世界をつかめ」のヘイリー・ゲイツ。監督・脚本は「ドリーム・シナリオ」「シック・オブ・マイセルフ」など独自の世界観をもつ作品で注目を集めるノルウェー出身のクリストファー・ボルグリ。製作には「ミッドサマー」のアリ・アスター監督が名を連ねる。
t1325734.synopsis_en: Charlie and Emma, who meet by fate at a Boston café, are living the happiest of days. On the night just seven days before their wedding, during dinner with their best friend couple who are also their attendants, they confess their worst past deeds. It starts as a lighthearted game, but everyone is utterly put off by Emma's 'worst secret.' Charlie begins to fear that Emma may have another side beyond his imagination. Their peak of happiness plummets into the depths of suspicion and paranoia, but there is no way to stop the wedding preparations, and the day finally arrives—.
t1325734.tmdb_overview_en: A happily engaged couple is put to the test when an unexpected turn sends their wedding week off the rails.

t31427.synopsis: 1959年に市川崑により映画化された大岡昇平の同名小説を塚本晋也の監督、脚本、製作、主演により再び映画化。日本軍の敗北が濃厚となった第2次世界大戦末期のフィリピン戦線。結核を患った田村一等兵は部隊を追放され、野戦病院へと送られる。しかし、野戦病院では食糧不足を理由に田村の入院を拒絶。再び舞い戻った部隊からも入隊を拒否されてしまう。空腹と孤独と戦いながら、レイテ島の暑さの中をさまよい続ける田村は、かつての仲間たちと再会する。戦場という異常な空間で極限状態に追い込まれた人間たちが描かれる。共演にリリー・フランキー、俳優デビュー作の「バレット・バレエ」以来の塚本監督作品への参加となるドラマーの中村達也。
t31427.synopsis_en: An anti-war film adapted from Shōhei Ōoka's novel of the same name, scripted by Kazuo Wada and directed by Kon Ichikawa. Abandoned by both the hospital and his unit, Tamura wanders the island of Leyte on the Philippine front. He reunites with fellow retreating soldiers in front of a hospital, but when the hospital comes under shelling, Tamura flees alone. With no food and having lost his comrades, Tamura survives by eating grass. Eventually he reunites with his former comrades Nagamatsu and Yasuda, who had been separated from him. The two call the soldiers they killed 'monkeys' and have been eating their flesh...
t31427.tmdb_overview_en: In the closing days of WWII, a Japanese soldier afflicted with tuberculosis is abandoned by his company and left to wander the Philippine island of Leyte.
t31427.tmdb_overview_jp: 大岡昇平の同名小説を、和田夏十が脚色し市川崑が監督した反戦映画。病院にも部隊にも見放された田村は、フィリピン戦線のレイテ島をさまよっていた。同じように敗走している仲間と病院の前で合流するが、その病院が砲撃を受けたため、田村は一人で逃げ出す。食べるものもなく、仲間を失った田村は、草を食べて生き延びていた。やがて生き別れたかつての仲間である永松と安田と再会。二人は殺した味方の兵士を“猿”と称し、その肉を食べていた…。

t2767.synopsis: フランスの鬼才レオス・カラックスが「ボーイ・ミーツ・ガール」「汚れた血」に続いて手がけたラブストーリー。アレックスという名を持つ青年を主人公に描く3部作の完結編にあたる。 パリで最も古く美しい橋・ポンヌフで暮らす大道芸人のアレックスは、ある日、失恋の痛手と治る見込みのない目の病に苦しみ放浪する画学生ミシェルと出会う。やがて2人はポンヌフで共に暮らし始め、孤独な日々の中で絆を深めていく。ジュリアンというチェリストへの恋の未練と、画家としての失明への恐怖を抱えるミシェル。そして、他人とのつながりを知らずに生きてきたアレックス。2人の間には、次第に絆と愛が芽生えていく。しかし、ミシェルはやがて両親が自分を捜していること、そして眼病の治療法が見つかったことを知り……。 主人公アレックスを演じるのは、「ボーイ・ミーツ・ガール」「汚れた血」に続いてドニ・ラバン。ミシェル役にはジュリエット・ビノシュが扮する。1991年製作、日本では1992年に公開され、渋谷・シネマライズで27週に及ぶロングランを記録する大ヒットとなった。2011年にニュープリント／HDリマスター版でリバイバル上映され、2025年には撮影監督キャロリーヌ・シャンプティエ監修による4Kリマスター版としてリバイバル公開される。
t2767.synopsis_en:
A love story from French visionary Leos Carax, following *Boy Meets Girl* and *Bad Blood*, this film serves as the final chapter of his trilogy centered on a young man named Alex. On the Pont-Neuf, the oldest and most beautiful bridge in Paris, a street performer named Alex encounters Michèle, an art student wandering the streets while suffering from the pain of a broken heart and a seemingly incurable eye disease. Before long, the two begin living together on the bridge, deepening their bond amidst their shared loneliness. Michèle struggles with lingering feelings for a cellist named Julien and the fear of losing her sight as an artist, while Alex has lived his life without ever knowing a true connection to others. Gradually, a profound love blossoms between them. However, Michèle eventually learns that her parents are searching for her and that a cure for her eye disease has been found...

Denis Lavant returns to play the protagonist Alex, following his roles in *Boy Meets Girl* and *Bad Blood*, while Juliette Binoche portrays Michèle. Produced in 1991 and released in Japan in 199

t63418.movie_title: ボーイ・ミーツ・ガール（1983）
t63418.movie_title_jp: ボーイ・ミーツ・ガール（1983）
t63418.clean_title_jp: ボーイ・ミーツ・ガール
t63418.synopsis: フランスの鬼才レオス・カラックスが1983年に発表した長編デビュー作。夜のパリをさまようふたつの孤独な魂の出会いを美しいモノクロ映像で描き、第37回カンヌ国際映画祭でヤング大賞を受賞するなど世界各地の映画祭で話題を集めた。 親友に恋人を奪われた青年アレックスは、恋人とケンカした女性ミレーユと運命的な出会いを果たす。アレックスはミレーユに一目ぼれするが、やがてふたりは思わぬ悲劇に見舞われる。 アレックス役とミレーユ役には、当時新人俳優だったドニ・ラバンとミレーユ・ペリエをそれぞれ抜てき。ラバン演じる主人公アレックスは、後に形を変えながら「汚れた血」「ポンヌフの恋人」の主人公となり、本作とあわせて「アレックス3部作」と呼ばれるようになった。ジャン＝イブ・エスコフィエが撮影を手がけ、続く2作品でも撮影を担当。日本では、1988年2月公開の「汚れた血」に続いて同年7月に劇場初公開された。2026年1月、4Kレストア版にてリバイバル公開。
t63418.synopsis_en: The feature debut of French maverick Leos Carax, released in 1983. It depicts the encounter of two lonely souls wandering through the Paris night in beautiful black-and-white imagery, winning the Youth Prize at the 37th Cannes Film Festival and generating buzz at festivals worldwide. Alex, a young man whose best friend stole his girlfriend, has a fateful encounter with Mireille, a woman who just fought with her lover. Alex falls in love with Mireille at first sight, but they soon meet with an unexpected tragedy. The roles of Alex and Mireille were played by then-newcomers Denis Lavant and Mireille Perrier. The protagonist Alex, played by Lavant, later reappeared in transformed forms in 'Bad Blood' and 'The Lovers on the Bridge', forming what is known as the 'Alex Trilogy' along with this film. Jean-Yves Escoffier handled the cinematography and continued as cinematographer for the subsequent two films. In Japan, it was first theatrically released in July 1988, following the release of 'Bad Blood' in February of the same year. A 4K restored version was re-released in January 2026.
t63418.tmdb_overview_en: In Paris at night, a young aspiring filmmaker grapples with heartbreak after his girlfriend leaves him for his best friend. After a failed attempt to confront his friend, he wanders the streets and encounters a girl who has just been abandoned. Their paths cross at a party, bringing together two tormented souls.
t63418.tmdb_overview_jp: 恋人フロランスに振られたばかりのアレックスは、いつも悲しげなモノローグをパリの街に浮かべるような孤独な男。部屋の壁に貼ったパリの地図に、フロランスが残した傷から自殺しようとしたという旨のメモを貼り付ける。一方、どこか遠い世界で暮らしているミレーユも、恋人ベルナールと喧嘩ばかりの日々。まるで別の夢であるかのように離れている二つの世界は、徐々に距離を縮め、ついに出会うことになるが…。

t76200.tmdb_overview_en: A married man who killed the wife of his best friend during a tryst feels compelled to turn himself in.

t31303.director: クロード・シャブロル
t31303.synopsis: フランスの名匠クロード・シャブロルが、「メグレ警部」シリーズで知られる作家ジョルジュ・シムノンによる同名小説を映画化。 アルコールに溺れる若い女性ベティは、「穴」という名のレストランで中年女性ローラと出会う。ベティの面倒を見ることにしたローラは、自分が宿泊しているホテルの隣の部屋に彼女を連れていく。やがてベティはローラに、自身の結婚生活や“奔放”になった過去について語りはじめるが……。 名優ジャン＝ルイ・トランティニャンの娘でシャブロル監督作「主婦マリーがしたこと」にも出演したマリー・トランティニャンがベティ、「女鹿」「ブルジョワジーの秘かな愉しみ」などのステファーヌ・オードランがローラを演じた。2026年8月、特集上映「クロード・シャブロル傑作選 vol.2」にてデジタルリマスター版で日本初公開。
t31303.synopsis_en: French master Claude Chabrol adapts the novel of the same name by Georges Simenon, known for the "Inspector Maigret" series. Betty, a young woman drowning in alcohol, meets a middle-aged woman named Laure at a restaurant called "The Hole." Laure decides to take care of Betty and brings her to a room next to her own in the hotel where she is staying. Soon, Betty begins to tell Laure about her married life and her past of becoming "promiscuous"... Marie Trintignant, daughter of the famous actor Jean-Louis Trintignant and who also appeared in Chabrol's "The Swindle," plays Betty, and Stéphane Audran (from "La Biche" and "The Discreet Charm of the Bourgeoisie") plays Laure. Screened for the first time in Japan in a digitally remastered version in August 2026 as part of the special screening "Claude Chabrol Masterpieces Vol. 2."
t31303.tmdb_overview_en: A drunken, self-destructive woman called Betty wanders into a Parisian bar where she meets middle-aged alcoholic Laure. Laure decides to take care of Betty. Recovering in a hotel room, Betty begins to recount to Laure the story of her bourgeois life and her unhappy and unfaithful marriage.

t26638.director: ミケランジェロ・アントニオーニ
t26638.synopsis: イタリアの名匠ミケランジェロ・アントニオーニの初のカラー作品で、1964年・第25回ベネチア国際映画祭で金獅子賞に輝いた心理ドラマ。 無機質な工場が立ち並ぶ海辺の工業都市ラヴェンナ。夫や息子と3人でこの街に暮らすジュリアーナは、数年前の交通事故のショックから立ち直れず、精神的に不安定な日々が続いていた。そんなある日、彼女は夫から友人コラドを紹介される。ジュリアーナは自分と同じように孤独を抱えるコラドに惹かれ、次第に距離を縮めていくが……。 アントニオーニ監督のミューズとして知られるモニカ・ビッティがジュリアーナ、イギリスの名優リチャード・ハリスがコラドを演じた。2026年8月、アントニオーニ初期5作を集めた特集上映「ミケランジェロ・アントニオーニ　レトロスペクティヴ　愛の不毛、彷徨える魂」にて、4K修復版で公開。
t26638.synopsis_en: The first color film by Italian master Michelangelo Antonioni, this psychological drama won the Golden Lion at the 25th Venice International Film Festival in 1964. In Ravenna, an industrial coastal city lined with sterile factories, Giuliana lives with her husband and son but remains unable to recover from the shock of a car accident years earlier, spending her days in emotional instability. One day, her husband introduces her to his friend Corrado. Giuliana is drawn to Corrado, who carries a loneliness similar to her own, and gradually the two grow closer... Monica Vitti, known as Antonioni's muse, plays Giuliana, with British star Richard Harris as Corrado. A 4K restored version will be released in August 2026 as part of the retrospective program "Michelangelo Antonioni Retrospective: Arid Love, Wandering Souls," featuring five of Antonioni's early works.
t26638.tmdb_overview_en: In an industrializing Italian town, a married woman, rendered mentally unstable after a traffic accident, drifts into an affair with a friend of her husband.
t26638.tmdb_overview_jp: 夫と息子と何不自由なく暮らすジュリアナだが、交通事故を起こし、精神的ショックによる後遺症に悩んでいた。ある日彼女は、夫に会いにった工場で、自分の居場所を見い出せずに苦しむコラドと知りあう。2人は次第に心を通わせ、距離を縮めていくが…。

n敗北者たち.director: ミケランジェロ・アントニオーニ
n敗北者たち.synopsis: 「情事」「赤い砂漠」で知られるイタリアの巨匠ミケランジェロ・アントニオーニが1953年に手がけた長編2作目で、フランス、イタリア、イギリスの各都市を舞台に、罪を犯す若者たちの姿を描いた群像劇のオムニバス。 パリ、ローマ、ロンドン。それぞれの街で、金銭欲や虚栄心、あるいは満たされない退屈から、青年たちが殺人や密輸といった犯罪に手を染めていく。豊かさを取り戻しつつある戦後社会の繁栄の裏側で、進むべき道を見失った若い世代の精神的な空白と、揺らいでいく価値観が静かに浮かび上がっていく。 監督・原案・脚本をアントニオーニが担い、「白夜」「山猫」などビスコンティ作品で知られるイタリアを代表する脚本家スーゾ・チェッキ・ダミーコ、作家ジョルジョ・バッサーニが共同脚本に名を連ねる。犯罪の背後にある疎外感や無気力を冷静に見つめるまなざしは、後のアントニオーニ作品へと受け継がれていく。日本では2026年8月の特集上映「ミケランジェロ・アントニオーニ レトロスペクティヴ 愛の不毛、彷徨える魂」にて、2K修復版で劇場初公開。
n敗北者たち.synopsis_en: The second feature film by Italian master Michelangelo Antonioni, known for "L'Avventura" and "Red Desert," made in 1953. An omnibus ensemble drama depicting young people who commit crimes, set in cities across France, Italy, and England. Paris, Rome, London. In each city, driven by greed for money, vanity, or unfulfilled boredom, young people turn to crimes such as murder and smuggling. Against the backdrop of postwar prosperity regaining its wealth, the spiritual emptiness of a younger generation that has lost its way, and shifting values, quietly come to the surface. Antonioni handled direction, original story, and screenplay, with Suso Cecchi D'Amico, a leading Italian screenwriter known for Visconti works like "White Nights" and "The Leopard," and writer Giorgio Bassani co-writing the script. His gaze, calmly observing the alienation and apathy behind crime, carries forward into his later works. In Japan, it will receive its theatrical premiere in a 2K restored version at the special screening "Michelangelo Antonioni Retrospective: The Futility of Love, Wandering Souls" in August 2026.

t99002.synopsis_en: In the port city of Marseille in southern France. Young Boni works at a pizzeria, spending his days belonging nowhere. One day, his long-estranged younger sister Nenette suddenly appears and crashes at his place. Having nowhere to go, Nenette carries a secret: she is pregnant. But she never reveals this fact to Boni. In their awkward cohabitation, the two spend time maintaining a distance they cannot cross. Boni develops feelings for a woman who works at a bakery, but cannot turn those feelings into reality. Nenette confronts her own body and tries to choose her future. In a cruel world, desire and tenderness quietly transform their relationship. Unspoken emotions slowly seep through.
t99002.tmdb_overview_en: Teenage siblings Nenette and Boni were raised apart as a result of their parents' divorce. Their mother, who doted on her son Boni, has died. He works for an interesting couple as a pizza baker, and is surprised and enraged when his younger sister, having run away from boarding school, suddenly turns up. There's a problem that they must confront.

t40723.synopsis_en: After becoming a test subject for a new drug, Core (Béatrice Dalle) develops an uncontrollable urge to kill her sexual partners during intercourse. American doctor Shane (Vincent Gallo) travels to France to find her, but...
t40723.tmdb_overview_en: Newlyweds Shane and June arrive in Paris for their honeymoon. In the process of trying to find a cure for his strange, bloodthirsty disease, Shane stumbles upon the story of a doctor and his flesh eating wife.
t40723.tmdb_overview_jp: ある新薬の実験台となり、性交中に相手を殺害する衝動を抱いてしまうようになったコレ(ベアトリス・ダル)。アメリカ人医師シェーン(ヴィンセント・ギャロ)は彼女を探すためにフランスにやってきたが……。

t294896.synopsis: “忘れ去られたヌーベルバーグの名匠”として再評価が進むギイ・ジル監督が1963年に発表した長編デビュー作で、若者たちのはかない愛をつづった自伝的作品。 夏の海辺で愛を確かめ合うジュヌヴィエーヴと水兵ダニエル。しかしバカンスが終わると、彼は港町ブレストへ、彼女はパリへと戻っていく。ふたりは再会を願い、手紙をつづり続ける。そこに、アルジェリア戦争から帰還したもう1人の水兵ギイが加わり、3人の思いは静かに交錯していく。 主演のダニエル・ムースマン、ジュヌビエーブ・テニエに加え、水兵ギイ役でギイ・ジル監督が自ら出演。ジャン＝ピエール・レオ、ジャン＝クロード・ブリアリ、アラン・ドロン、ジュリエット・グレコら名優たちが脇を固めた。ギイ・ジル監督が1959年に手がけた短編「Au biseau des baisers」を気に入った名匠ジャン＝ピエール・メルビルが製作資金の一部を援助した。ロカルノ国際映画祭で批評家賞を受賞。日本では2026年4月に劇場公開。
t294896.synopsis_en:
The 1963 feature debut of Guy Gilles—a director currently being rediscovered as a "forgotten master of the Nouvelle Vague"—is an autobiographical work that captures the fleeting love of youth. On a summer shore, Geneviève and Daniel, a sailor, find love in each other's arms. But when the vacation ends, he returns to the port city of Brest while she goes back to Paris. Hoping for a reunion, they continue to write to one another. Their story expands with the arrival of Guy, another sailor returning from the Algerian War, as the paths and emotions of the three quietly interweave. 

Starring Daniel Moosmann and Geneviève Thénier, the film also features director Guy Gilles himself as the sailor Guy, with a supporting cast of legendary actors including Jean-Pierre Léaud, Jean-Claude Brialy, Alain Delon, and Juliette Gréco. Impressed by Gilles’ 1959 short *Au biseau des baisers*, the master Jean-Pierre Melville provided partial funding for the film. A winner of the Critics’ Prize at the Locarno Film Festival, it will be released in Japanese theaters in April 2026.
t294896.tmdb_overview_en: During her holiday in Brest, a young Parisian falls in love with a sailor. But autumn comes and the two lovers have to part. They write to each other. Will their love resist at a distance, each living his life, him in Brest with his friends, she in Paris who keeps waiting for him? An impossible love story and the cross-portrait of two cities, Paris and Brest, between the realism of the color images and the poetry infused by the sepia black and white images, lives to the rhythm of the nostalgia of the two lovers...

t298621.synopsis: “忘れ去られたヌーベルバーグの名匠”として2000年代以降に再評価が進められてきたギイ・ジル監督が、死を選んだ恋人との記憶とともに生きる女性を描いた長編第2作。現在をモノクロ映像、追想の断片をカラー映像で描き、愛の記憶と不在の痛みを繊細かつメランコリックに映し出す。 ジャンヌは亡き恋人ジャンを思い返しながら、いまも彼の記憶とともに生きている。ジャンは社会の秩序やブルジョワ的世界を拒み、ビート族の世界にも居場所を見いだせず、自ら死を選んだ。彼の死を知らないジャンヌには、いつまでも彼が寄り添い、亡霊のように存在し続ける。 「恋人のいる時間」「昼顔」のマーシャ・メリルが主人公ジャンヌを演じ、「海辺の恋」撮影中にギイ・ジル監督と出会い彼の人生と創作においてかけがえのない存在となった俳優パトリック・ジョアネが亡き恋人ジャン役を務めた。日本では2026年4月に劇場公開。
t298621.synopsis_en: The second feature film by Guy Gilles, a director re-evaluated since the 2000s as a 'forgotten master of the French New Wave,' depicting a woman living with the memory of her lover who chose death. The present is shown in black-and-white, and fragments of recollection in color, delicately and melancholically portraying the memory of love and the pain of absence. Jeanne lives with the memory of her deceased lover Jean. Jean rejected social order and the bourgeois world, found no place in the Beat generation, and chose death. Unaware of his death, Jeanne feels him always by her side, existing like a ghost. Masha Meril, known for 'A Time for Loving' and 'Belle de Jour,' plays the protagonist Jeanne, and Patrick Jouané, an actor who met Guy Gilles during the filming of 'Le Rempart des Béguines' and became an irreplaceable presence in his life and work, plays the deceased lover Jean. The film was released in Japanese theaters in April 2026.
t298621.tmdb_overview_en: Jeanne looks back on her love for Jean. The melancholic young man wouldn't accept the world as it was, always wishing to depart. She doesn't know that he's dead.

t400033.movie_title: Tokyo Melody Ryuichi Sakamoto 4Kレストア版
t400033.movie_title_jp: Tokyo melody, un film sur Ryuichi Sakamoto
t400033.movie_title_en: Tokyo Melody: A Film About Ryuichi Sakamoto
t400033.clean_title_jp: Tokyo melody, un film sur Ryuichi Sakamoto
t400033.movie_title_original: Tokyo melody, un film sur Ryuichi Sakamoto
t400033.synopsis_en:
"I want to film a documentary on Ryuichi Sakamoto for a French television program." In 1983, director Elizabeth Lennard visited Sakamoto in Berlin—where he was attending a David Sylvian recording session—to make this proposal. In May 1984, just as Sakamoto began work on his fourth solo album, *Ongaku Zukan*, filming took place in Tokyo over a brief span of only one week. The five-member French crew, led by Lennard, captured a vivid record of Japan, the city of Tokyo, and the musician Ryuichi Sakamoto.

Following its 1985 completion and French TV broadcast, the film screened at international festivals in Rotterdam, Locarno, and São Paulo. In Japan, it premiered at the inaugural Tokyo International Film Festival on June 9th of that year. While the subsequent VHS and DVD releases were long out of print and difficult to obtain, the original 16mm film was recently discovered in a warehouse and has been digitally restored.

Within its 60-minute runtime, the film captures a 30-something Sakamoto in the studio and in interviews, discussing his upbringing, values, musical philosophy, and culture. It also features footage from Nagisa Oshima’s *Merry Christmas, Mr. Lawrence* (1983), YMO’s "scatter" concerts, and music videos, while projecting the vibrant energy of 1980s Tokyo—from the Shibuya Scramble to Shinjuku Alta—onto the screen. This legendary documentary, an immersion into the "Sounds of Tokyo" as seen through Sakamoto’s eyes and portrait, finally makes its theatrical debut after nearly 40 years.
t400033.tmdb_overview_en: Documentary about the eclectic Japanese composer Ryuichi Sakamoto during the recording sessions for his 1984 album "Illustrated Musical Encyclopedia".

t1030653.movie_title: エリス＆トム ─ボサノヴァ名盤誕生秘話─
t1030653.movie_title_jp: Elis & Tom: Só Tinha de Ser com Você
t1030653.movie_title_en: Elis & Tom: It Had to be You
t1030653.clean_title_jp: Elis & Tom: Só Tinha de Ser com Você
t1030653.movie_title_original: Elis & Tom: Só Tinha de Ser com Você
t1030653.synopsis_en: A documentary recording the recording sessions for "Elis & Tom," the acclaimed 1974 album by Brazilian star singer Elis Regina and Antônio Carlos Jobim (Tom Jobim), one of the founders of bossa nova. Long-buried original footage, unseen for nearly half a century, has been restored in 4K and supplemented with modern interviews. Elis, a national star under Brazil's military regime, and Tom, who gained worldwide fame with the hit "The Girl from Ipanema" in the 1960s and was active in America, clashed badly—the pop star Elis and Tom, who preferred the old, simple music, were a poor fit, and tensions also arose between Tom and Elis's then-husband and arranger, César Camargo Mariano. Through testimonies from family, associates, and band members, along with archival footage, the film depicts their musical differences and the conflicts surrounding the recording. Roberto de Oliveira, who managed Elis and later worked as a director and producer at a TV station, co-directed and appears in the film to testify about Elis's complex state of mind and the chaotic atmosphere at the time.
t1030653.tmdb_overview_en: Elis & Tom is considered one of the most important albums in the history of Brazilian music. Recorded in Los Angeles, in 1974, it was all captured by a team of filmmakers led by director Roberto de Oliveira, who arranged for the duo to meet. The original footage was kept for 45 years until restored and remastered in 2018. The film is also an exciting reunion of the director with the artists and the material he filmed nearly five decades ago.

t996764.movie_title: にわのすなば GARDEN SANDBOX ※26(土),27(日)は休映
t996764.synopsis_en: The first feature film produced by Kinokoya, a cafe bar in Tama, Tokyo, that screens independent films. Sakaguchi visits an unfamiliar town called Tobako for a job interview at a friend's invitation, but finding the work unreasonable, he turns down the job and tries to go home. However, for some reason he can't leave easily, and as he wanders the town he repeatedly encounters mysterious meetings and partings. Filmed in Ryoke, Kawaguchi City, Saitama Prefecture, an area once prosperous from casting industries and still home to factory districts, the film captures traces of suburban landscapes being lost amid the changing times through the figure of its wandering protagonist. The cast includes Kawashima Marino ("Fuyu suru Sakai me") and Murakami Yukino ("Orphans' Blues," "On the Street"). Directed by Kurokawa Yukinori ("Village on the Village").
t996764.tmdb_overview_en: After some misunderstanding, Sakaguchi is hired to make a tourist guide video on Tobako (a fictitious name for Kawaguchi) in the outskirts of Tokyo. This element in the script sparks off a fanciful wandering strewn with unexpected meetings. First with Kitagawa, thanks to whom Sakaguchi landed the job. Then with a seamstress, and then with Yoshino, with whom a half-hearted romance emerges. Thus the narrative unfolds, in halts and swerves, espousing unexpected meetings, and offering the strolling character an opportunity for displacements from one place to the next. The deserted town has come to a standstill - the shooting took place during the lockdown - and this acts as a metaphor for the idleness of the characters. GARDEN SANDBOX is light and nimble, whereas its main character hasa limp. Her demeanour and her stiff body exude a peculiar quality, somewhat comically at odds with the setting.

t51862.tmdb_overview_en: Joe Grant, a light-skinned African American, heads to a small Southern town to investigate the lynching death of his brother. He draws the attention of a gorgeous heiress whom he learns may have been involved in the killing.

nみれんデジタル修復版tbsレトロスペクティブ映画祭石井ふく子特集.synopsis: ともこ(渡辺美佐子)は小杉(下元勉)と8年間も不倫していたが、かつてともこを当時の夫から奪った年下の男・涼太(小池朝雄)ともいまだに関係していた。嫉妬深い二人の男の狭間で揺れる女心を描く、瀬戸内寂聴の初期作。激しい情念の世界で「女の生き様」というテーマが息づいている。 . .
nみれんデジタル修復版tbsレトロスペクティブ映画祭石井ふく子特集.synopsis_en: Tomoko (Misako Watanabe) has been carrying on an affair with Kosugi (Tsutomu Shimomoto) for eight years, yet she is still also involved with Ryota (Asao Koike), the younger man who once stole her away from her then-husband. An early work by Jakucho Setouchi depicting a woman's heart wavering between two jealous men. Within a world of fierce passion, the theme of "a woman's way of life" breathes throughout.

n秋津温泉デジタル修復版tbsレトロスペクティブ映画祭石井ふく子特集.synopsis: ある日、数年ぶりに秋津温泉を訪ねた貧しい作家の周作(児玉清)。若女将の新子(大空眞弓)は待ち焦がれた再会に胸を躍らせるが、周作はすでに妻子ある身だった。そこに周作がかつて憧れた未亡人の女や、新子の縁談の相手まで絡み、複雑な大人の恋模様が展開される。演出は、後に「岸辺のアルバム」や「ふぞろいの林檎たち」を手掛ける鴨下信一。 . .
n秋津温泉デジタル修復版tbsレトロスペクティブ映画祭石井ふく子特集.synopsis_en: One day, Shusaku (Kiyoshi Kodama), a poor writer, visits Akitsu Onsen for the first time in several years. The young proprietress Shinko (Mayumi Ozora) is thrilled at the long-awaited reunion, but Shusaku is already a married man with children. Into the mix come a widow he once admired and a prospective suitor for Shinko, setting in motion a complex tale of adult romance. Directed by Shinichi Kamoshita, who would later helm "Album by the Riverside" and "Uneven Apples."

t1561.movie_title: 少女ムシェット 4Kレストア
t1561.director: ロベール・ブレッソン
t1561.synopsis_en: Master filmmaker Robert Bresson's eighth feature, made right after his masterpiece "Au Hasard Balthazar." Based on a novel by French author Georges Bernanos, it starkly and realistically depicts the tragic fate of a young girl through rigorous framing and the actors' minimally restrained performances. 14-year-old Mouchette lives in the French countryside, forced to run the household for her alcoholic father and ill mother, while being cruelly treated by classmates and teachers at school. The unfortunate girl's fate takes a turn for the worse when, one rainy night, she encounters a poacher in the forest, sending her spiraling into further misery and ruin. Nadine Nortier, discovered for this role, plays the protagonist Mouchette, a girl standing on the brink of despair yet harboring a rebellious spirit. Produced in 1967, it was first released in Japan in 1974 by Equipe de Cinema, and again in 1995 by France Eiga Sha. A 4K restored digital remastered version had a revival release in October 2020. Another revival release is scheduled for 2026 as part of the "Robert Bresson Masterpiece Selection."
t1561.tmdb_overview_en: A young girl living in the French countryside suffers constant indignities at the hand of alcoholism and her fellow man.
t1561.tmdb_overview_jp: 14歳のムシェット。家庭の貧困と父の暴力と、同級生の豊かさと美しさ、そして土曜の午後のカンタータの練習に痛めつけられる少女。森番の洩らす秘密を知って、約束を守ると誓ったのに犯されてしまう無垢な肉体。しかし、その秘密すらただの幻影に過ぎなかったと分かって、少女は完全な孤立を味わう。そんな彼女に残された選択は……。ブレッソンが、「田舎司祭の日記」の原作者G・ベルナノスの小説を、自ら脚色して映画化。

t1638776.movie_title_jp: あの星が降る丘で、君とまた出会いたい。
t1638776.movie_title_en: Till We Meet Again on the Starry Hill
t1638776.clean_title_jp: あの星が降る丘で、君とまた出会いたい。
t1638776.movie_title_original: あの星が降る丘で、君とまた出会いたい。
t1638776.synopsis: 汐見夏衛によるベストセラー小説を実写映画化し、現代から1945年にタイムスリップした女子高生と特攻隊員の切ない恋を描いた2023年の大ヒット作「あの花が咲く丘で、君とまた出会えたら。」の続編にして完結編。続編小説「あの星が降る丘で、君とまた出会いたい。」を原作に、愛する人を理不尽な形で失った後、現代で目を覚ました主人公・百合のその後を描く。 特攻隊員・彰との別れから7年。百合は彰の夢でもあった高校教師になり忙しい毎日を過ごしながらも、その心は1945年の百合が咲く丘に取り残されたままだった。そんな彼女の前に、彰の面影を感じさせる青年・涼が現れる。彼は臨時適任用教員として、百合のクラスの副担任になるという。自分をまっすぐに想ってくれる涼に揺れ動く百合だったが、彰を裏切るようで新たな恋に踏み出すことができない。葛藤のなかで百合が出会ったのは、ホスピスで穏やかな余生を過ごす年老いた千代だった。石丸を失った後、千代が歩んだもうひとつの愛の形。そして千代が百合に託したのは、出撃直前の彰が遺した、未来の百合へ送る1冊の本だった。 キャストには百合役の福原遥をはじめ、出口夏希、伊藤健太郎ら前作のメンバーが再結集。さらに、彰の面影を持つ青年・涼役で細田佳央太、現代の千代役で倍賞千恵子が出演。「366日」の新城毅彦が監督を務め、前作に引き続き福山雅治が主題歌を担当。
t1638776.synopsis_en: The sequel and conclusion to the 2023 blockbuster 'Till We Meet Again on the Lily Hill', a live-action adaptation of Shiomi Natsue's best-selling novel, which depicted the poignant love between a high school girl who time-travels from the present to 1945 and a kamikaze pilot. Based on the sequel novel 'I Want to Meet You Again on That Starry Hill', it follows the story of Yuri, the protagonist, after she wakes up in the present day, having lost her beloved in a senseless manner. Seven years have passed since her parting with Akira, the kamikaze pilot. Yuri has become a high school teacher, a dream of Akira's, and leads a busy life, but her heart remains left behind on that lily-covered hill in 1945. A young man named Ryo, who bears a resemblance to Akira, appears before her. He is a temporary teacher assigned as the deputy homeroom teacher for Yuri's class. Yuri is swayed by Ryo's straightforward affection, but she cannot bring herself to embrace a new love, feeling it would betray Akira. Amidst her inner conflict, Yuri meets Chiyo, an elderly woman spending her peaceful final days in a hospice. It's another form of love that Chiyo walked after losing Ishimaru. And what Chiyo entrusts to Yuri is a book left by Akira just before his sortie, addressed to the future Yuri. The cast reunites members from the previous film, including Fukuhara Haru as Yuri, Deguchi Natsuki, and Ito Kentaro. Additionally, Hosoda Kanata plays Ryo, the young man with Akira's likeness, and Baisho Chieko plays the elderly Chiyo. Directed by Niinobe Katsuhiko of '366 Days', with the theme song performed by Fukuyama Masaharu, continuing from the previous film.
t1638776.tmdb_overview_en: Yuri, a high school teacher, lives her busy days carrying a sacred "vow" in her heart: to fulfill the dream of the one she loved, Akira, who aspired to be a teacher but perished in the flames of war. One day, a temporary teacher named Ryo appears. Yuri finds herself constantly seeing traces of Akira in Ryo's casual gestures and words. Though confused by her wavering heart, she desperately tries to suppress her feelings for him, having resolved to love only Akira for the rest of her life.
t1638776.tmdb_overview_jp: あの星が降る丘で、君とまた出会いたい。

t1077877.synopsis: 「野火」「斬、」の塚本晋也監督が、終戦直後の闇市を舞台に絶望と闇を抱えながら生きる人々の姿を描いたドラマ。 焼け残った小さな居酒屋に1人で住む女は、体を売ることを斡旋され、絶望から抗うこともできずに日々をやり過ごしていた。そんなある日、空襲で家族を失った子どもが、女の暮らす居酒屋へ食べ物を盗みに入り込む。それ以来、子どもはそこに入り浸るようになり、女は子どもとの交流を通してほのかな光を見いだしていく。 「生きてるだけで、愛。」の趣里が主人公の女を繊細かつ大胆に演じ、片腕が動かない謎の男役で森山未來、戦争孤児役で「ラーゲリより愛を込めて」の子役・塚尾桜雅、復員した若い兵士役で「スペシャルアクターズ」の河野宏紀が共演。2023年・第80回ベネチア国際映画祭オリゾンティ部門に出品され、優れたアジア映画に贈られるNETPAC賞（最優秀アジア映画賞）を受賞した。
t1077877.synopsis_en: Director Shinya Tsukamoto, known for "Fires on the Plain" and "Killing," depicts the lives of people carrying despair and darkness in the black market just after the end of the war. A woman living alone in a small, surviving izakaya is forced into selling her body and spends her days without the will to resist, overwhelmed by despair. One day, a child who lost their family in an air raid sneaks into the woman's izakaya to steal food. From then on, the child begins to frequent the place, and through her interaction with the child, the woman begins to find a faint glimmer of light. Hikari Mitsushima, known for "Just Remembering," delivers a delicate yet bold performance as the protagonist, the woman. Mirai Moriyama plays a mysterious man with a paralyzed arm, Sōga Tsukao, a child actor known for "The Last 10 Years," plays a war orphan, and Hironori Kōno, known for "Special Actors," plays a young repatriated soldier. It was screened in the Orizzonti section of the 80th Venice International Film Festival in 2023 and won the NETPAC Award (Best Asian Film Award).
t1077877.tmdb_overview_en: In the black market, a war orphan is confronted with the struggles of people living in the immediate aftermath of WWII.
t1077877.tmdb_overview_jp: 「野火」「斬、」の塚本晋也監督が、終戦直後の闇市を舞台に絶望と闇を抱えながら生きる人々の姿を描いたドラマ。  焼け残った小さな居酒屋に1人で住む女は、体を売ることを斡旋され、絶望から抗うこともできずに日々をやり過ごしていた。そんなある日、空襲で家族を失った子どもが、女の暮らす居酒屋へ食べ物を盗みに入り込む。それ以来、子どもはそこに入り浸るようになり、女は子どもとの交流を通してほのかな光を見いだしていく。  「生きてるだけで、愛。」の趣里が主人公の女を繊細かつ大胆に演じ、片腕が動かない謎の男役で森山未來、戦争孤児役で「ラーゲリより愛を込めて」の子役・塚尾桜雅、復員した若い兵士役で「スペシャルアクターズ」の河野宏紀が共演。2023年・第80回ベネチア国際映画祭オリゾンティ部門に出品され、優れたアジア映画に贈られるNETPAC賞（最優秀アジア映画賞）を受賞した。

t35717.synopsis_en: The fourth feature film by French wunderkind Leos Carax, released eight years after 'The Lovers on the Bridge.' An adaptation of the novel 'Pierre' by 19th-century American author Herman Melville, written the year after his masterpiece 'Moby-Dick.' Shifting the setting to modern-day Paris, it uses emotional imagery and sound to depict the intense, racing love of a man and woman swept up by fate and drawn into despair. Pierre, a young novelist living in a Norman castle, enjoys a wealthy, contented rural life with his mother Marie and fiancée Lucie. One day, Isabelle, a Bosnian refugee claiming to be Pierre's half-sister, appears. Drawn to Isabelle's charm, Pierre abandons everything and heads to Paris with her. Guillaume Depardieu, son of Gérard Depardieu, passionately plays Pierre, and Katerina Golubeva, known for 'Paris at Night,' plays Isabelle. Catherine Deneuve co-stars as Pierre's mother Marie. Cinematography is by Éric Gautier, known for 'My King,' and music is by singer-songwriter Scott Walker. A 4K restored version will be re-released in February 2026.
t35717.tmdb_overview_en: A writer leaves his upper-class life and journeys with a woman claiming to be his sister, and her two friends.
t35717.tmdb_overview_jp: 『ポンヌフの恋人』の鬼才レオス・カラックスが、発表当時“狂気の書”と評されたハーマン・メルヴィルの『ピエール』を映画化。森に囲まれたノルマンディの城館で母と暮らす、仮面小説家のピエール。婚約者リュシーとの結婚も間近に控えたある日、彼は自分の姉だと名乗る黒髪の女と出会う……。

n愛と殺意.director: ミケランジェロ・アントニオーニ
n愛と殺意.synopsis: イタリアが誇る巨匠ミケランジェロ・アントニオーニが1950年に発表した長編デビュー作。資本家の妻とその元恋人が織りなす愛憎劇をノワール調に描いたドラマ。 ミラノの資本家エンリコは、美しい妻パオラの過去の素行を探偵に調査させる。皮肉にも、その調査がきっかけとなってパオラはかつての恋人グイドと再会する。愛のない結婚生活に飽きていた彼女は、グイドとの関係に情熱を取り戻していく。夫による調査が進むなか、2人は次第に危険な関係へと足を踏み入れていく。 パオラを演じるのは、「リュミエール」「ラスト・ハーレム」などに出演したミラノ出身の女優ルチア・ボゼー。元恋人グイド役を、「郵便配達は二度ベルを鳴らす」「夏の嵐」などルキノ・ビスコンティ作品への出演で知られるマッシモ・ジロッティが務めた。現代人の孤独や男女の愛の不毛を見つめ続けたアントニオーニが、その後の作品にも通じる人間関係の疎外を、早くも描き出した一作。日本では2026年8月の特集上映「ミケランジェロ・アントニオーニ レトロスペクティヴ 愛の不毛、彷徨える魂」にて、4K修復版で劇場初公開。
n愛と殺意.synopsis_en: The feature-length debut by Italy's master filmmaker Michelangelo Antonioni, released in 1950. A noir-toned drama of love and hatred woven between a capitalist's wife and her former lover. Milan capitalist Enrico hires a detective to investigate the past conduct of his beautiful wife Paola. Ironically, this investigation leads Paola to reunite with her former lover Guido. Bored with her loveless marriage, she rediscovers passion in her relationship with Guido. As her husband's investigation progresses, the two gradually step into a dangerous affair. Paola is played by Milan-born actress Lucia Bosè, who appeared in "Lumière" and "Last Harem." The role of former lover Guido is played by Massimo Girotti, known for his appearances in Luchino Visconti works such as "The Postman Always Rings Twice" and "Summer Storm." In this work, Antonioni—who continually examined modern loneliness and the futility of love between men and women—already depicts the alienation in human relationships that would carry through his later films. In Japan, it will receive its theatrical premiere in a 4K restored version at the special screening series "Michelangelo Antonioni Retrospective: The Futility of Love, Wandering Souls" in August 2026.

t198654.synopsis: 「狂った果実」「月曜日のユカ」などの鬼才・中平康が自身のプロダクション・中平プロの第1弾として1971年に手がけた作品で、幕末の土佐で活動した天才絵師・絵金の生きざまを映画化。20歳の青年・金蔵がさまざまな出来事を経て、残酷描写や過激な性表現、ユーモアが混在した作風で知られる異端の絵師「絵金」となるまでの姿を描き、第24回カンヌ国際映画祭コンペティション部門に出品されるも、そのあまりの血みどろな描写で物議をかもした。 20歳の絵師・金蔵は長身でたくましい体躯だが、傲慢で不潔という不名誉な陰口を叩かれていた。江戸に遊学していた彼は3年ぶりに故郷・土佐に戻り、「絵金」として活動を始める。権力にあらがい己のみを信じて描きあげた絵金の作品は、やがて多くの人々を魅了するようになる。 主人公・絵金を麿赤兒が鬼気迫る演技で怪演し、扇ひろ子、加賀まりこが共演。榎本滋民の「血みどろの絵金」を原作に、新藤兼人が脚本を手がけた。2025年10月には、新宿・K's cinemaで開催の「奇想天外映画祭2025」にてデジタルリマスター版で上映。
t198654.synopsis_en: A film by the maverick director Nakahira Ko, known for works like "Kurutta Kajitsu" and "Getsuyobi no Yuka," produced in 1971 as the first project of his own production company, Nakahira Pro. It depicts the life of Ekin, a genius painter active in Tosa at the end of the Edo period. The film portrays the journey of a 20-year-old youth named Kinzo as he goes through various events to become the heretical painter "Ekin," known for his style mixing cruel depictions, radical sexual expression, and humor. It was submitted to the competition section of the 24th Cannes International Film Festival, where its excessively bloody depictions caused controversy. Kinzo, a 20-year-old painter, is tall and sturdy, but is subjected to the dishonorable gossip of being arrogant and filthy. After studying in Edo, he returns to his hometown of Tosa after three years and begins working as "Ekin." Ekin's works, painted in defiance of authority and trusting only in himself, eventually captivate many people. Maro Akaji gives a hauntingly intense performance as the protagonist Ekin, with Ogi Hiroko and Kaga Mariko co-starring. Based on Enomoto Shigemi's "Chimidoro no Ekin," with a screenplay by Shindo Kaneto. In October 2025, a digitally remastered version will be screened at the "Kiten Tentai Eigasai 2025" held at K's cinema in Shinjuku.
t198654.tmdb_overview_en: The film depicts the youth of Kinzo, a heretic painter who worked in Tosa during the late Edo period, and the hurricane-like inner side of his life.

This documentary delves into the essence of Fukuko Ishii through a long interview in which she speaks in 2026 about the origins of her creativity, behind-the-scenes stories of her masterpieces, and her ongoing "present" as she keeps running as an active producer — interwoven with rare footage from the past.

n時間ですよデジタル修復版tbsレトロスペクティブ映画祭石井ふく子特集.synopsis: . 銭湯「泉湯」の女主人(森光子)は大の働き者だが、その夫(中村勘三郎)は女癖が悪くいつも遊んでいた。ある日近所の未亡人が妊娠、しかもその相手が女主人の夫だという噂が立ち...。「ただの水で稼ごうなんて、水商売もいいとこだわ」など橋田セリフの切れ味は素晴らしく、女性の働き方や生活保護問題など、すでに令和の社会問題を扱っている。森光子は石井の母と交流があった。 . .
n時間ですよデジタル修復版tbsレトロスペクティブ映画祭石井ふく子特集.synopsis_en: The proprietress of the public bathhouse Izumiyu (Mitsuko Mori) is a hard worker, but her husband (Kanzaburo Nakamura) is a womanizer who is always out playing around. One day, a neighborhood widow becomes pregnant, and rumors spread that the father is the proprietress's husband... Hashida's dialogue is razor-sharp, as in lines like 'Trying to make a living with just plain water—that's the bathhouse business for you,' and the story already deals with social issues relevant to the Reiwa era, such as women's working conditions and public assistance. Mitsuko Mori had a personal connection with Ishii's mother.

t20108.director: ロベール・ブレッソン
t20108.synopsis_en: The 7th feature film by master director Robert Bresson, known for "L'Argent," "Pickpocket," and "The Trial of Joan of Arc," released in 1966. Inspired by an episode from Dostoevsky's novel "The Idiot," it portrays the strange fate of a donkey and a young girl. In a small Pyrenean village, little Marie names a newborn donkey Balthazar and cherishes him. Ten years later, Balthazar is used for hard labor by a blacksmith but escapes the suffering and returns to Marie. The grown Marie rejoices at their reunion and takes Balthazar with her, but Gérard, who has feelings for her, becomes jealous and torments the donkey. Through the silent perspective of the donkey, the film calmly depicts human folly and ugliness, winning the Special Jury Prize at the Venice International Film Festival and earning acclaim as a masterpiece. Starring Anne Wiazemsky, who later appeared in many Godard films including "La Chinoise," in her film debut. First theatrically released in Japan in 1970, and again in 1995 distributed by France Eigasha. Revived in October 2020 in a 4K restored digital remaster. Also revived in 2026 as part of "Robert Bresson Masterpiece Selection."
t20108.tmdb_overview_en: The story of a donkey Balthazar as he is passed from owner to owner, some kind and some cruel but all with motivations beyond his understanding. Balthazar, whose life parallels that of his first keeper, Marie, is truly a beast of burden, suffering the sins of humankind. But despite his powerlessness, he accepts his fate nobly.
t20108.tmdb_overview_jp: ピレネーの小村。教師の娘マリーは農園主の息子ジャックと共に、生まれたばかりのロバに“バルタザール”と名前をつけ可愛がる。ある日ジャックが引っ越すことになり、バルタザールもどこかへ行ってしまう。10年後、バルタザールが再び現れ、マリーが喜んであちこち“彼”に馬車を引かせ出かけるのを見て、彼女に思慕を寄せる不良のジェラールは嫉妬し、バルタザールを痛めつけ、実家のパン屋の仕事にこき使う・・・。

t1493022.tmdb_overview_en: Twenty years ago, believing she was doomed, Irma took a trip to Greece. Today, she retraces that journey, accompanied by three young men. From island to island, between sky and sea, the travelers read, listen and live, carried by a longing for beauty and clarity.

t64131.synopsis: フランスの鬼才レオス・カラックスが1986年に手がけた長編第2作。監督デビュー作「ボーイ・ミーツ・ガール」に始まるアレックス3部作の第2作で、結ばれない男女の三角関係を独自の映像センスと鮮烈な色彩でスピーディに描き、弱冠25歳にして映画作家としてのカラックスの評価を決定づけた一作。 愛のないセックスにより感染する奇妙な病気「STBO」が蔓延した近未来のパリ。空虚な日々を過ごす青年アレックスは父が不可解な死を遂げた後、父の友人であるギャングの男マルクから犯罪に誘われる。マルクを手伝うことにしたアレックスは、彼の愛人であるアンナにひかれていくが……。 「ボーイ・ミーツ・ガール」に続いてドニ・ラバンが主人公アレックスを演じ、名優ミシェル・ピコリが父の友人マルク、キャリア初期のジュリエット・ビノシュがマルクの愛人アンナを演じた。後にアメリカで「グッド・ウィル・ハンティング　旅立ち」などを手がけるジャン＝イブ・エスコフィエが「ボーイ・ミーツ・ガール」に引き続き撮影を担当。1986年度ルイ・デリュック賞、第37回ベルリン国際映画祭アルフレッド・バウアー賞を受賞。2026年1月、4Kレストア版にてリバイバル公開。
t64131.synopsis_en: In a Paris plagued by STBO—a mysterious disease contracted through loveless sex—Alex is a young man who has lived with a sense of nihilism and isolation since childhood. Even in the company of his lover, Lise, the emptiness remains. Stricken by unexplained abdominal pains and weary of his existence, he is consumed by the need to change his life. It is then that his estranged father is killed by a train. Marc, an old friend of his father, finds himself saddled with the dead man's massive debts and devises a plan to steal and traffic the STBO serum. He seeks out Alex as the essential recruit for the job. Alex joins the heist, but when he meets Marc’s lover, Anna, he feels a profound sense of destiny, and the story begins to unfold.
t64131.tmdb_overview_jp: 愛の無いセックスで感染する奇病STBOが蔓延するパリ。幼少の頃から虚無感や孤独感に生きてきた青年アレックスは、恋人リーズと居る時も虚しさは同じだった。原因不明の腹痛にも襲われ生活に嫌気がさしたアレックスは、人生を何とかして変えなければと考え続けていた。そんな矢先、行方知れずの父親が電車に轢かれ死んでしまう。アレックスの父親の友人マルクは彼の多大なる借金を背負うこととなり、STBOの血清を盗み密売する作戦を考え出す。そしてその作戦に必要な人材としてアレックスを見つけ出す。アレックスは作戦に乗るが、そこでマルクの恋人であるアンナにかつてない運命を感じ、物語は動き始める。

t324375.tmdb_overview_en: A publishing company is working on a book about Umezu’s life. The lead editor, Sakura, knows that Umezu’s late mother Ichie was very influential to his work. As the investigation continues, bizarre incidents begin occurring one after another. Soon, the grudge of a mother who should be dead sparks mounting fear around Umezu.
